February 26, 1933. Morning Translation.

COMMUNISM

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

SUCCESSION OF A COMMUNIST LEADER.

Sung Chi Ming (宋奇明), a former important element of the Chinese Communist Party, severed his connection with the Communist Party several days ago.
He studied in the China University (中国大学), Moscow and joined the Communist Party in 1927. In 1930 he returned to China and was appointed Secretary of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Youth Group of the Communist Party, member of the Presidium of the Central Executive Committee and concurrently Chief of the Organization Department of the Committee. Realising now that Communism is unsuitable to China and seeing that Communists are creating trouble in the rear of the Chinese armies even at this time of national crisis, Sung determined to secede from the Communist Party.
At 10 a.m. yesterday, the Intelligence Office of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai invited local journalists to meet Sung Chi Ming.
Huang Yung Hwa (黄永华), Chief of the Special Service Section of the Public Safety Bureau, stated that Sung Chi Ming was an important member of the Chinese Communist Party. He participated in the Communist activities in France, England, Germany, Italy and other foreign countries but he has now suddenly severed his connection with the Communist Party because he fully realises the mistake of the Party.
Sung Chi Ming then delivered the following speech:-
"The reason of my severing all connection with the Communist Party is that I now feel that the movement for the emancipation of the Chinese race has reached a critical stage. At the present moment when the Japanese Imperialists are attacking China, our country must concentrate her whole strength to deal with Japan. The history of the people's movement in the Balkan Peninsula shows that in order to achieve emancipation, a people must concentrate their entire force. The emancipation movement of the Chinese people is different from those of other countries because she is being attacked by the Imperialists on the one hand and by Communists on the other. This is sapping her strength. The Chinese Government can not dispatch strong forces to resist the Japanese invasion because of trouble being created by the "Red" bandits in the interior. Thus the force of the Government is divided. The Communist Party must be annihilated. After the September 18 Incident, the "Red" bandits ordered a general mobilization of their forces in Kiangsi, Honan, and other provinces with the object of interfering with the movements of the Chinese armies. The Communists are not only incapable of emancipating the people, but they are increasing their distress and disturbing the peace, which affect the country to such an extent that we can not deal with foreign invaders. 共产主义

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

共产领袖更迭。

宋奇明（宋奇明），前中国共产党重要分子，数日前已与共产党断绝关系。
他曾就读于莫斯科中国大学（中国大学），并于1927年加入共产党。1930年他返回中国，被任命为共产党青年团江苏省委书记、中央执行委员会主席团成员，并兼任该委员会组织部部长。鉴于目前共产主义不适合中国，且看到共产党人在国家危机时刻仍在国军后方制造麻烦，宋决定脱离共产党。
昨日上午10时，大上海市政府情报处邀请当地记者会见宋奇明。
公安局特务科科长黄永华（黄永华）表示，宋奇明是中国共产党的重要成员。他曾参与在法国、英国、德国、意大利及其他外国的共产主义活动，但因充分认识到党的错误，现已突然与共产党断绝关系。
随后，宋奇明发表如下演讲：
“我与共产党断绝一切关系的原因在于，我现在感到中华民族解放运动已到达关键阶段。在日本帝国主义者攻击中国的当下，我国必须集中全部力量对付日本。巴尔干半岛人民运动的历史表明，为了实现解放，人民必须集中全部力量。中国人民的解放运动与其他国家不同，因为她一方面受到帝国主义者的攻击，另一方面受到共产主义者的攻击。这正在削弱她的力量。由于内地‘赤’匪制造麻烦，中国政府无法派遣强力部队抵抗日本入侵。因此政府的力量被分散。必须消灭共产党。九一八事变后，‘赤’匪命令其在江西、河南等省的部队总动员，目的是干扰中国军队的行动。共产党人不仅无力解放人民，反而增加人民的苦难并扰乱治安，其影响致使国家无法应对外国侵略者。如果迟……”

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

PRECAUTIONS AGAINST TROUBLE BY UNEMPLOYED.

Yesterday the Chinese and Settlement authorities
received a report that local reactionary elements were about
to utilize the unemployed to call at the Tangpu and other
political organs during the day to submit an appeal but
really with the object of creating trouble.
The Public Safety Bureau yesterday maintained
precautionary measures and additional post duty policemen
were sent out. Policemen and detectives patrolled the
streets and special precautions were taken in the vicinity
of the Social Affairs Bureau on Chung Hwa Road and the
Shanghai Tangpu on Ling Ying Road.
The Settlement Police also adopted precautionary
measures, particularly in the Eastern District.
At 8 a.m. yesterday, seven suspected persons
were arrested by the Chinese Police in Chapei and radical
handbills were found in their possession. They were
immediately taken to the Public Safety Bureau for enquiries.
No other untoward incidents happened throughout the day.

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

防范失业者滋事。

昨日，中方及租界当局收到报告称，当地反动分子企图利用失业人员，于日间前往塘沽及其他政治机关提交请愿书，实则旨在制造麻烦。
公安局昨日维持预防措施，并增派岗警外出。警察和侦探在街道巡逻，并在中华路社会局附近及灵英路上海塘沽附近采取特别预防措施。

Description of Foreigners suspected of being Agents of the
III International and in touch with Chinese Communists.

On November 18, 1932 the Municipal Police discovered the archives
of the National Headquarters of the Chinese Communist Youth League at
House No.22, Lane 42, Kiaochow Road and arrested two Chinese named
Zung Ping Woo (程和平) and Zung Ching Zai (程金才) who were found
on the premises. In the course of interrogation Zung Ping Woo and
Zung Ching Zai disclosed that members of the Standing Committee of the
Communist Youth League used to receive advice and discuss Communist
matters with two foreigners whose descriptions are as follows:-

(1). Height, over 6'; Age, 20 to 25; build, big and inclined to stout-
ness; dresses very smartly; face, thin, long; fresh complexion;
few pimples; nose, long and prominent; hair, brown, parted at
left side; eyes, brown; ears, big and wide, shoulders, wide;
Believed to be Russian.

(2) Height, about 5' 9"; slim build; smartly dressed; long pale face;
deep set blue eyes; prominent teeth, one protruding from upper
front set; brown hair en brosse; wears horn rimmed glasses with
golden ear pieces; Believed to be American.

On February 1, 1933 the Municipal Police in collaboration with the
Chinese Authorities arrested three Communists; Sung Chi Ming (宋志明)
Wong Yoong Zung (王永诚) and Yang Peng Tsung (楊本真) at House 5,
Lane 56 Medhurst Road, where the Chinese Communist Youth League had
established a new National Headquarters.

Wong Yoong Zung, a Moscow trained Communist, who at the time of
his arrest was the Secretary of the Communist Youth League, in a
statement to the Municipal Police, asserted that in February 1933 he
and an interpreter proceeded to a certain foreign house on Bubbling
Well Road, near Gordon Road, where they met a foreigner with whom
they discussed various phases of Communism and from whom they re-
ceived instructions as to how they should proceed with Communist
work. Wong described this foreigner as follows:-
Age, over 30.
Height, about 5' 8"; stout build; smartly dressed; dark wavy
hair short at the back; wears glasses; good teeth at the front;
broad round face with a mole on the right cheek; high forehead;
dark eyebrows; big mouth; hairy hands; dark gloves; speaks
English and Russian. Believed to be a Russian Jew.

档案 D 485 c/
关于疑似为第三国际代理人并与中国共产主义者有联系的外国人的描述。

1932年11月18日，市警务处在胶州路42弄22号发现了中国共产主义青年团全国总部的档案，并逮捕了在现场的两名中国人，名为程和平（Zung Ping Woo）和程金才（Zung Ching Zai）。在审讯过程中，程和平和程金才透露，共产主义青年团常务委员会成员曾与两名外国人接受建议并讨论共产主义事务，这两名外国人的体貌特征如下：

(1). 身高，6英尺以上；年龄，20至25岁；体格，高大且倾向肥胖；衣着非常时髦；脸型，瘦长；肤色红润；少量粉刺；鼻子，长而突出；头发，棕色，左侧分缝；眼睛，棕色；耳朵，大而宽；肩膀，宽阔；据信为俄罗斯人。

(2) 身高，约5英尺9英寸；身材苗条；衣着时髦；脸色苍白的长脸；深陷的蓝眼睛；牙齿突出，上排门牙中有一颗 protruding（突出）；头发棕色，短发直立（en brosse）；佩戴金脚玳瑁框眼镜；据信为美国人。

1933年2月1日，市警务处与中国当局合作，在麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）56弄5号逮捕了三名共产主义者：宋志明（Sung Chi Ming）、王永诚（Wong Yoong Zung）和杨本真（Yang Peng Tsung），此处是中国共产主义青年团新设立的全国总部所在地。

王永诚是一名在莫斯科受训的共产主义者，被捕时担任共产主义青年团书记，他在向市警务处所作的陈述中声称，1933年2月，他和一名翻译前往静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）靠近戈登路（Gordon Road）的一处外籍人士住宅，在那里他们会见了一名外国人，与其讨论了共产主义的各个阶段，并从该人那里接受了关于如何开展共产主义工作的指示。王对该外国人的描述如下：
年龄，30岁以上。
身高，约5英尺8英寸；体格粗壮；衣着时髦；深色波浪卷发，后部较短；戴眼镜；前牙良好；圆宽脸，右颊有一颗痣；高额头；浓眉；大嘴；手部多毛；戴深色手套；讲英语和俄语。据信为俄罗斯犹太人。

1933年1月期间，当Nong Yoong Aung（音译）在共产主义青年团工作时，他和宋奇明在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）靠近国泰电影院的一处住宅内多次会见一名外国人。他们与该外国人讨论共产主义事务，并从他那里收到关于党活动的指示和建议。该外国人的体貌特征如下：

THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, FEBRUARY 26, 1933.
（印：SHANGH Municipal Library No. D 4454 Date 27/1 '33 p.2）

CONFUSION OVER
COMMUNISM

Story of Repentance Told
by Red

ASSISTANCE GIVEN TO
JAPANESE

A Moscow-trained Chinese Communist, who became "repentant" and surrendered himself to the Greater Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety after holding several high posts in official Communist circles for nearly eight years, was invited yesterday by the City Government to meet members of the press and to speak of his past experiences and the reasons why he had severed his relations with the Reds. The meeting took place in the City Government's office and was attended by Mr. T. Y. Chang, a secretary to Gen. Wu Te-chen, the Mayor.

The penitent referred to was Sun Chi-hua, a native of Huang Mei, Hupeh. He joined the Red movement in 1926 and, after receiving training in Moscow for several years, was sent by the Third Internationale to study conditions in Europe. Returning to China in 1930, he was called on to act as a secretary to the Kiangsu Provincial Communist Party and later to be a member of the Communist Council. He surrendered himself to the Chinese authorities recently when he became disgusted with the methods used by the Reds in China.

Ruinous to the Nation

At yesterday's reception, Sun told those present that he joined the radical movement believing that it would be advantageous to the people, but that now he realised he had made a mistake and that Communism was ruinous to the nation. He stated that two reasons had prompted him to sever his relations with the Communist Party.

The first was the means of realizing the destruction of China. Sun declared that in the prosecution of a war against foreign aggressors, the Red Army, instead of assisting the Government troops in the situation in Jehol, did everything to embarrass the authorities by causing further disturbances in South China. He asserted that the provinces occupied by the Reds were in a state of chaos and that the people were suffering from heavy taxation, forced labour, and other oppressive measures. He added that the Reds were not only destroying the country but were also aiding the Japanese invaders by creating internal disorder.

The second reason was the moral degradation of the Communist leaders. Sun claimed that many of the so-called revolutionary leaders were corrupt and self-seeking, using the movement for their own personal gain. He described how some leaders lived in luxury while the common people starved, and how they exploited the peasants and workers under the guise of liberation.

Sun concluded by appealing to all Chinese to unite against the common enemy and to support the National Government in its efforts to restore peace and order. He expressed his hope that his repentance would serve as an example to others who might still be misled by Communist propaganda.

共产主义引发的混乱

赤色分子讲述悔过故事

协助日本人

一名在莫斯科受训的中国共产主义者，在官方共产主义圈子担任要职近八年后“悔过”并向大上海公安局自首，昨日受邀参加市政府举行的记者见面会，讲述其过往经历以及与赤色分子断绝关系的原因。会议在市政府办公室举行，市长吴铁城将军的秘书张T. Y.先生（音译）出席。

所述悔过者为孙志华（Sun Chi-hua，音译），湖北黄梅人。他于1926年加入赤色运动，在莫斯科受训数年后，被第三国际派往欧洲研究局势。1930年返回中国后，他被召任江苏省共产党书记，后任共产党委员会委员。近期，因对赤色分子在中国使用的手段感到厌恶，他向中方当局自首。

祸国殃民

在昨日的招待会上，孙告诉在场人士，他当初加入激进运动是相信这对人民有利，但现在他意识到自己犯了错误，共产主义对国家具有破坏性。他表示，有两个原因促使他与共产党断绝关系。

第一个是实现毁灭中国的手段。孙宣称，在对抗日外国侵略者的战争中，红军非但没有在热河局势中协助政府军，反而通过在华南制造进一步动荡来使当局陷入困境。他断言，被赤色分子占领的省份处于混乱状态，人民遭受重税、强迫劳役和其他压迫措施的苦难。他补充说，赤色分子不仅在毁灭国家，还通过制造内部混乱来协助日本侵略者。

第二个原因是共产党领导人的道德堕落。孙声称，许多所谓的革命领导人腐败且自私自利，利用运动谋取个人利益。他描述了一些领导人生活奢侈，而平民百姓却在挨饿，以及他们如何打着解放的幌子剥削农民和工人。

孙最后呼吁所有中国人团结起来对抗共同敌人，支持国民政府恢复和平与秩序的努力。他表示希望自己的悔过能作为榜样，警示那些可能仍被共产主义宣传误导的人。

（手写批注：$2 9K selaye）

Illegal Functioning in the Settlement by members
of the Chinese Authorities

Shortly after 3.30 p.m. February 1, 1933, a party
of Police from Bubbling Well Station in answer to a call
proceeded to House No.5, Lane 56, Medhurst Road, where
it was ascertained that Inspector Lieu Kuh Jing (吕克勤)
attached to the Political Branch of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, in company with certain Chinese males,
had entered the premises and effected the arrest of two
male and one female Chinese communists and in doing so,
had seriously injured the two former persons. Neither
Inspector Lieu or any of his colleagues informed any
member of the Municipal Police that they were watching
or had suspicions against people living in this neighbour-
hood, and they failed to tell the police station concerned
or even police on street duty in the vicinity that they
intended to enter the house.

At the entrance of this particular alleyway a
Chinese Police Watchman was stationed, and Lieu could
have requested this individual to either help him or obtain
assistance from a Police Station.

中国当局成员在租界内的非法活动

1933年2月1日下午3点30分过后不久，静安寺捕房的一队警察应召前往麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）56弄5号。经查实，上海公安局政治分部所属的吕克勤（Lieu Kuh Jing）督察与若干中国男子进入该处所，逮捕了两名男性和一名女性中国共产党员，并在过程中严重殴伤了前两名男性。吕督察及其同僚均未通知任何一名工部局警务人员他们正在监视或怀疑居住在该地区的人员，也未告知相关捕房或甚至在附近执勤的巡警他们打算进入该房屋。

在该弄堂入口处驻有一名中国巡捕，吕本可以请求此人协助或从捕房获得援助。

(1) Handbill entitled "Work of the Manchuria

The Manchuria Provincial Committee (C.Y.) has decided
to carry out the following plans between September 18 and
November 15, 1932:-

A. Direction of the struggles of young labourers and labour
unions.

(1) To instigate workers of electricity works, docks, and
machine shops to carry out struggles and to oppose
reduction of staff and imposition of fines; to urge
the workers of aeroplane factories to continue their
strikes; and to start the struggles of seamen and
young labourers of the Chinese Eastern Railway.
Harbin To start within one month the struggles of
young workers of small cotton mills and tobacco
factories along the Pei-Ning Railway (Peking-
Mukden Line). To start within two months the
struggles of workers of large cotton mills and
clothing and bedding makers.
Dairen To start within one month the struggles of young
workers of Fu-sung (撫順) Coal Mine.
To start within two months the struggles of young
workers of the South Manchuria Railway and those
in Dairen.

(2) To establish young workers sections in the following
industrial concerns:- Shipbuilding works, electricity
factories & tobacco factories along the Pei-Ning Railway,
aerodromes. Efforts should be made to increase the
membership by 100% within one month, that is--before
November 18.
To establish within two months young workers sections
in the following concerns:-
South Manchuria Railway, Fu-sung Coal Mine, Lao Pah Kuo
(老巴奪), Chinese-Eastern Railway, and large cotton mills.

(3) To call representatives meetings of young workers at the
following places:- Harbin, Mukden.

(4) To restore the activities among the workers of the
"Tao-Wai" (道外) Railway and to start activities among
workers of the Chinese Eastern Railway, printing workers,
and shoe-makers.

(5) To start activities among unemployed young workers,
especially the number unemployed workers of the Chinese
Eastern Railway. A conference of unemployed workers
should be called and an unemployed workers group organized.

(6) To hold mass meetings of young workers at any place
and draft the general principles of struggle of young
workers, (Railway, mines, arsenal, shipbuilding works,
municipal workers, cotton mills, tobacco factories, etc.).

1933年2月1日在麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）56弄5号查获的三份共产主义传单，即证物第6号的译文。

(1) 标题为“满洲省委（共青团）在冬季风暴运动中的工作”的传单，日期为1932年9月18日。

满洲省委（共青团）决定在1932年9月18日至11月15日期间执行以下计划：-

A. 指导青年劳工和工会的斗争。

(1) 煽动电厂、码头和机器厂的工人进行斗争，反对裁员和罚款；敦促飞机厂工人继续罢工；并发动海员和中东铁路青年劳工的斗争。
哈尔滨 在一个月内发动北宁铁路（京沈线）沿线小型棉纺厂和烟草厂青年工人的斗争。在两个月内发动大型棉纺厂以及服装和被褥制造工人的斗争。
大连 在一个月内发动抚顺煤矿青年工人的斗争。
在两个月内发动南满铁路青年工人和大连青年的斗争。

(2) 在下列工业企业中建立青年工人部：- 北宁铁路沿线的造船厂、电厂和烟草厂，以及飞机场。应努力在一个月内，即11月18日之前，将会员人数增加100%。
在两个月内在下列企业建立青年工人部：-
南满铁路、抚顺煤矿、老巴夺、中东铁路和大型棉纺厂。

(3) 在下列地点召开青年工人代表会议：- 哈尔滨、沈阳。

(4) 恢复“道外”铁路工人的活动，并在中东铁路工人、印刷工人和鞋匠中开展活动。

(5) 在失业青年工人中开展活动，特别是中东铁路的大量失业工人。应召开失业工人会议并组织失业工人小组。

(6) 在任何地方举行青年工人群众大会，并起草青年工人斗争的一般原则（铁路、矿山、兵工厂、造船厂、市政工人、棉纺厂、烟草厂等）。

B. Direction of the struggles of peasants and refugees.

(1) To direct young peasants in Manchuria in the movement
to oppose outrageous taxation and to refuse to pay
rentals during the autumn season.

(2) To direct the young workers at Pan Chih and Liao Ti,
Manchuria, in snatching rice and food from rich
families.

(3) To carry out activities among the refugees at Harbin,
Mukden and other places, call a conference of representative
of refugees, and instigate them to besiege municipal
organs, to occupy foreign styled houses, and to join the
volunteer armies.

C. Extension of the racial war.

(1) To increase the number of vanguards at Pan Chih (磐石)
to carry out guerilla war, snatch rice, distribute land,
and occupy territories as military bases.

(2) To send 20 workers from Harbin to participate in guerilla
war; to send 25 persons from Mukden to work among the
volunteer armies at Liao Si; to send 20 persons from
each district in Harbin to work among the volunteer
armies at various places and to kill their reactionary
senior officers; to organize soldiers committees and to
enforce land revolution.

(3) To organize youth volunteer armies in factories, schools,
and villages.

(4) To organize youth vanguards in cities and towns, factories
and workshops.

D. Work among 'White' Armies.

(1) A large number of comrades, after a short period of
training, be sent from Harbin and Mukden for work among
'White' armies, and 6 comrades be sent from each district
to work among the 'White' Army stationed in their
respective districts.

(2) Two soldiers branches be established at Mukden and Harbin,
and special vanguards be organized for work among Japanese
soldiers.

(3) Red Army Friendly Societies and Volunteer Army Friendly
Societies be organized in 'White' armies and an Anti-
Militarism Committee be organized.

E. Work to support Soviet Russia and Red Armies.

(1) To organize within one month Soviet Friendly Societies
and Red Army Friendly Societies among the workers of
shipbuilding companies, tobacco factories and Pei-Ning
Railway.

(2) The work to support the Soviet movement should be
discussed at every mass meeting and educational talks,
and manifestoes should be issued.

(3) To propagate the victories of Red Armies at every mass
meeting.

B. 指导农民和难民的斗争。

(1) 指导满洲的青年农民开展反对苛捐杂税的运动，并在秋季拒绝交租。

(2) 指导满洲磐石和辽堤的青年工人从富户手中抢夺大米和食物。

(3) 在哈尔滨、沈阳等地难民中开展活动，召开难民代表会议，煽动他们包围市政机关，占领西式房屋，并加入义勇军。

C. 扩大种族战争。

(1) 增加磐石的先锋队人数，以开展游击战，抢夺大米，分配土地，并占领领土作为军事基地。

(2) 从哈尔滨派遣20名工人参加游击战；从沈阳派遣25人到辽西在义勇军中开展工作；从哈尔滨各区各派遣20人到各地在义勇军中开展工作，并杀害其反动高级军官；组织士兵委员会并推行土地革命。

(3) 在工厂、学校和村庄组织青年义勇军。

(4) 在城市、城镇、工厂和车间组织青年先锋队。

D. 在“白军”中的工作。

(1) 大量同志经过短期训练后，从哈尔滨和沈阳派往“白军”中开展工作，并从各区各派遣6名同志到驻扎在各自区的“白军”中开展工作。

(2) 在沈阳和哈尔滨建立两个士兵支部，并组织特别先锋队在日本士兵中开展工作。

(3) 在“白军”中组织红军之友社和义勇军之友社，并组织反军国主义委员会。

E. 支援苏俄和红军的工作。

(1) 在一个月内，在造船公司、烟草厂和北宁铁路的工人中组织苏维埃之友社和红军之友社。

(2) 应在每次群众大会和教育讲座上讨论支援苏维埃运动的工作，并发布宣言。

(3) 在每次群众大会上宣传红军的胜利。

(2) REPORT FROM COMRADE YANG (楊), IN MANCHURIA ON
THE GENERAL SITUATION IN MANCHURIA.

The general situation in Manchuria is still
serious. Although there are more than one thousand
armed comrades at Kirin and Fengtien, the connections with
of the Communist Youth League with Eastern Manchuria have
not as yet been restored. The League directs neither
the struggles of the workers of the Chinese Eastern
Railway, the Pei-ning Railway, seamen and electricity workers,
nor the movements of the numerous volunteer armies who
are fighting against the Japanese imperialists. Work among
refugees is in suspension and the representative meetings
of young workers and the Children Group have failed to
bring about any result. It is evident that the new
Provincial Committee of Manchuria does not understand
thoroughly the real meaning of the Winter Storm Movement
and is still under the influence of right-leaning tendencies.

The 3rd month of the Winter Storm Movement has
already commenced. Inspectors for various Hsiens are
being trained and will be dispatched soon.

(3) REPORT FROM DISTRICT COMMITTEE IN MANCHURIA ON THE
UNSATISFACTORY WORK OF COMRADE YU TSUNG DING (于宗鼎).

This report alleges that Comrade See, who is
working among refugees, conducts an extravagant life and
neglects his daily duties.

(2) 杨同志关于满洲总体局势的报告。

满洲的总体局势依然严峻。虽然吉林和奉天有一千多名武装同志，但共青团与东满的联系尚未恢复。团委既不指导中东铁路、北宁铁路、海员和电力工人的斗争，也不指导众多抗击日本帝国主义的义勇军的运动。难民工作处于停滞状态，青年工人代表会议和儿童团未能取得任何成果。显然，满洲新省委并未彻底理解冬季风暴运动的真正含义，仍受右倾倾向的影响。

冬季风暴运动的第三个月已经开始。各县视察员正在接受培训，并将很快派出。

(3) 满洲区委关于于宗鼎同志工作不力的报告。

本报告指控从事难民工作的谢同志生活奢侈，忽视日常职责。

ttention is also being paid to the propaganda in
the hite districts and among the hite armies. The regular
propaganda matters are in the form of booklets entitled "Red
Army and the White Army", "Don't believe in the devilish talk
of the Kuomintang" and "Pay for the toiling masses".
(5) Economic work of the Party: The Soviet is enforcing
the following economic policies:-
a) 16 trade institutions have been established for
the purpose of exporting Soviet products and importing those
goods required in the Soviet district. The monthly turnovers
amount to $200,000, out of which a profit ranging from $12,000
to $18,000 can be made.
b) Co-operation clubs have been formed and over
80,000 persons have joined the membership of these clubs.
c) There are 3 paper mills capable of producing
500 quires of paper daily. This quantity is sufficient to
meet the requirements throughout the Soviet district. Besides
there are 2 coal yards, 5 boiler factories, 12 coffin works and
1 spinning and weaving mill, all of which have employed many
jobless workers.

(6) Financial Work of the Party:
a) The land tax has been greatly revised and reduced.
At present 120,000 piculs of rice can be procured from the land
tax which is quite sufficient for the maintenance of the Red
Army. Previously the land tax was extravagantly wasted, but
now it is decided to issue rice coupons in two kinds, A. and B.
Coupon A is for the Red Army-each is entitled to 3 "tau" and 8
"sin" of rice a month, while Coupon B is for the working staff
of the various organs - each man is entitled to 2 "tau" and 8
"sin" of rice a month.
b) 3 Ship Inspection Offices have been inaugurated.
The monthly revenue from this source amounts to $18,000 or
$18,000, the rate being from 1% to 8%.
c) The Soviet Bank has been established with a capital
of $180,000. $70,000 worth of banknotes have been issued. The
bank has also advanced loan $20,000 to the poor people.
d) There is still deficit in the monthly income and
expenditure. The monthly military expenditure is $38,000,
$9,000 for the Soviet, $6,000 for the Party expenses and
$2,000 for the peoples' organizations.

(7) Communication Work:
a) Red Postal Offices have been established. Scant
stamp is required to affix to a letter to be delivered to any
distance.
b) Telephones have been installed at Kuh Yuen, but
all these are obtained from the military telephones used by
the enemy. A wireless station is also in existence.

(8) General Work:
a) Revolutionary tribunals have been established in
the Soviet District. Corrupt gentries, etc., are being tried.
Revolutionary criminal laws have also been promulgated.
b) Opium smoking and gambling have been stopped.

(9) The Red Armies have now been increased by three times
since they were during the first suppression campaign by the
Imperialist Kuomintang. At present there are 7 regiments of
men. The firearms in possession of the Red Armies are:
8,000 rifles, 32 machine guns, 33 Lewis guns and 40 hand
machine guns.
In North-Eastern Kiangsi there is an arsenal which
employs 256 workers, 5,000 rounds of ammunition can be
manufactured daily. Pistols, Lewis guns and other firearms
are being repaired in this arsenal.

The Provincial Committee in North-Eastern Kiangsi.

(5) 党的经济工作：苏维埃正在执行以下经济政策：-
a) 已建立16个贸易机构，旨在出口苏区产品并进口苏区所需货物。月营业额达200,000元，从中可获利12,000元至18,000元不等。
b) 已组建合作社俱乐部，加入这些俱乐部的会员人数超过80,000人。
c) 有3家造纸厂，每日可生产500令纸张。此数量足以满足整个苏区的需求。此外，还有2个煤场、5家锅炉厂、12家棺材铺和1家纺织厂，所有这些工厂都雇佣了许多失业工人。

(6) 党的财务工作：
a) 田赋已大幅修订并减免。目前通过田赋可征收120,000担大米，这完全足以维持红军的给养。此前田赋被肆意浪费，但现在决定发行两种米票，即A类和B类。A类票供红军使用——每人每月有权领取3斗8升大米；B类票供各机关工作人员使用——每人每月有权领取2斗8升大米。
b) 已设立3个船舶检查处。由此来源获得的月收入为18,000元或18,000元（原文如此），税率为1%至8%。
c) 苏维埃银行已成立，资本为180,000元。已发行价值70,000元的钞票。该银行还向穷人发放了20,000元贷款。
d) 月度收支仍存在赤字。每月军费开支为38,000元，苏维埃经费9,000元，党务经费6,000元，人民团体经费2,000元。

(7) 通讯工作：
a) 已设立红色邮局。寄往任何距离的信件只需贴少量邮票。
b) 顾园（Kuh Yuen，音译）已安装电话，但这些电话均是从敌人使用的军用电话中缴获的。此外还设有一个无线电台。

(8) 一般工作：
a) 苏区内已设立革命法庭。正在审判腐败绅士等人员。革命刑法也已颁布。
b) 吸食鸦片和赌博已被禁止。

(9) 自帝国主义国民党进行第一次“围剿”以来，红军兵力已增加三倍。目前共有7个团。红军拥有的枪械包括：
8,000支步枪，32挺机枪，33挺刘易斯机枪和40挺手提机枪。
在江苏东北部有一个兵工厂，雇佣工人256名，每日可制造子弹5,000发。手枪、刘易斯机枪及其他枪械均在该兵工厂进行维修。

江苏东北部省委。

一名姓梁的男子受命针对1938年11月警方在天津逮捕王平同志一事开展对抗工作。近期拟实施的提案应包括以下几点：-
(1) 帝国主义国民党对反帝工人的措施。
(2) “王”式恐怖主义的详情。
(3) 当局镇压劳资纠纷的情况。
(4) 汉奸的详情。
(5) 王平的履历——国际反帝工会运动联盟委员会委员。

实际措施：以公共团体、学生、农民、反帝组织和激进社团的名义发布通告、标语和抗议书，应敦促群众发出抗议，要求立即释放王平及其他政治犯。共青团应募集救济款项。
上述工作应在数日内完成。

我方群众应努力迫使民权保障同盟采取必要行动。

苏维埃政府可能会发表宣言，提出用红军俘虏的国民党官员交换王平及其他政治犯。

党和青年团应以自身名义发表抗议，绝不对国民党逮捕同志采取被动态度。

Ia(1)：江苏省委应立即指示工厂工人讨论开展抗议逮捕王平及其他反帝领袖的运动，并组织营救委员会。我们应指派人员参加民权保障同盟，以迫使其采取行动保护民权，如有必要，应开展群众运动推翻其领导层。还应在天津和北平开展群众运动，要求释放王平等人。

Ia(2)：江苏省委应立即开展以下工作：-
(1) 组织一个团体，以促成释放被监禁的反帝工人。
(2) 敦促以下单位的工人发出抗议：丝厂、人力车夫、第九厂（T Sung Sing Co., 9 Mill，音译）、英美烟草公司、Sung Sing Co.（音译）二厂，以及上海第九厂。
(3) 以学校和文化娱乐团体等公共团体的名义打入民权保障同盟。
(4) 省委应发布一份关于汉奸详情的宣言。

Presidium of re-elected strike committee. More than
37 men from one telegraph station. Conditions of struggle
are now better. Struggle delayed owing to threats by
yellow running dogs.

According to what we know today, we have not moved
deeply into this struggle. We have therefore decided
to undertake the following:-
(1) To establish an opposition party.
(2) To establish direct connection with the committee to
participate in the strike committee.
(3) To devise ways and means to unite the T'ye lo labour
unions.

Owing to the interruption of communications by tram
traffics, the struggle is not carried out energetically.
We have to send experienced hands to direct the movement.

If the strike continues, attention should be paid
to the establishment of connection with the Strike
Committee and the livelihood of the pickets.

We have discussed the direction of the struggle
by the provincial committee of the party and the labour
union. We have observed the negligence of the Labour
union; so we have decided to send an efficient worker
to assist in directory work.

The present situation is favourable as the capitalists
have received numerous complaints through telephone
against mistakes made by messengers and are greatly
handicapped. They are adopting a more conciliatory
attitude towards the settlement of the dispute.

The Red Opposition Clique does not have a fixed
organization; there are only 13 persons who are unsatisfied
with the 'yellow' labour union. No meeting has ever
been held by the Red Opposition Clique.

Strikers have held several meetings, at one of which
more than 60 persons attended.

At a meeting held by the Chinese company (?) on Sunday,
it was decided to declare a strike of the "main station"
(? wireless station) and to appoint three persons to
direct the strike.

Party, Group, and Mass organizations: Sections, 23
persons. There are 12 others who have not yet held a
conference. The Party has 5 persons who have not yet
organized an independent branch. Social Science Research
Society, 41 persons. Mutual Benefit Society (in the
form of labour), more than 70 persons, who are operators
and general duty officers. Mutual Progressive Society,
more than 60 persons.
Main Station: 40 messengers, 60 operators, 40 general duty
officers, 30 mechanics.
Wireless Station: 30 messengers, 40 operators, 30 general
duty officers, 15 mechanics.
Telegraph Sta.: 60 messengers, 30 operators, 7 general duty
officers, 40 mechanics.

三张纸上包含关于一次法院讨论的记录。

罢工委员会改选主席团。来自一个电报局的37多人。斗争形势现已好转。由于黄色走狗的威胁，斗争曾一度延误。

根据我们今天所了解的情况，我们尚未深入参与这场斗争。因此我们决定采取以下行动：-
(1) 建立一个反对派政党。
(2) 与委员会建立直接联系，以参与罢工委员会。
(3) 设法联合“铁罗”（T'ye lo，音译）工会。

由于电车交通导致通讯中断，斗争开展得不够有力。我们必须派遣经验丰富的人员来指导运动。

如果罢工继续，应注意建立与罢工委员会的联系，并关注纠察队员的生计问题。

我们讨论了由党省委和工会指导斗争的问题。我们观察到工会的疏忽；因此我们决定派遣一名得力干部协助指导工作。

目前的形势是有利的，因为资本家通过电话收到了大量关于信差失误的投诉，受到极大阻碍。他们在解决纠纷方面正采取更为缓和的态度。

红色反对派小团体没有固定的组织；只有13人对“黄色”工会不满。红色反对派小团体从未举行过会议。

罢工工人举行过几次会议，其中一次有60多人参加。

Translation of Document "A", Exhibit No. 3, seized from
Jo. Co 5, Lane 56, Harbin, on February 1, 1933.

"CENTRAL" TO MANCHURIAN COMMITTEE.

Comrades of Manchurian Committee,

The "Central" considers it necessary to give
the following instructions for the furtherance of the
various movements in Manchuria:
1) To consolidate the force of the League under
the guidance of the Party and to arm thousands and thousands
of juvenile workers and farmers to join the Volunteer Armies.
2) To cause the anti-imperialistic struggles and
the Land Revolution to co-operate and to strengthen the
anti-Japanese, anti-imperialist, land revolution and Soviet
propaganda among the Volunteer Armies.
3) To establish Soldiers Committees and Representative
Committees among the Volunteer Armies as well as branches of
the League.
4) To conduct extensive propaganda among Volunteer
Armies, in factories, farming villages, army camps and
schools on the success of the socialist construction of
the Soviet Union and also on the victories of the Red Armies
in the Chinese Soviet Districts.
5) To accelerate the organization of picketing
groups among transportation workers (railway employees,
seamen, wharf coolies, etc.) and the railway guards of Japan
and Manchukuo with a view to opposing them from transporting
munitions for the attack on Soviet Russia and Volunteer
Armies.
6) To organize vast Youth Vanguard Corps among
Volunteer Armies and to urge these latter to participate
in struggle of social revolution.
7) To conduct extensive movement of rendering
support to the Red Armies in Soviet Districts and to the
Volunteer Armies.
8) To accelerate the work among the peoples of
Korea and Mongolia.

"Central"
November 12,

“中央”致满洲委员会。

满洲委员会同志们：

“中央”认为有必要发出以下指示，以推进满洲地区的各项运动：
1) 在党的指导下巩固联盟的力量，武装成千上万的青年工人和农民加入义勇军。
2) 促使反帝斗争与土地革命相互配合，并在义勇军中加强抗日、反帝、土地革命和苏维埃的宣传。
3) 在义勇军中建立士兵委员会和代表委员会，以及联盟的分支机构。
4) 在义勇军、工厂、农村、军营和学校中广泛开展宣传，介绍苏联社会主义建设的成就以及中国苏区红军的胜利。
5) 加速在运输工人（铁路员工、海员、码头苦力等）以及日本和伪满洲国的铁路警卫中组织纠察队，以阻止他们为进攻苏联俄罗斯和义勇军运输军火。
6) 在义勇军中组织庞大的青年先锋队，并敦促后者参与社会革命斗争。
7) 广泛开展支援苏区红军和义勇军的运动。
8) 加速在朝鲜和蒙古人民中的工作。

“中央”
11月12日，

The following resolutions have been passed at
a meeting of the Mukden Special Committee relating
to the October Revolution:
1) That the demands of farmers for non-payment
of taxes and of farm hands for higher wages be utilized
to instigate agrarian revolt. It is also that juvenile
farmers and other agrarian be organized.
2) That street committees and sections be reorganized
and reorganized to undertake the organization of the return
movement.
3) That the masses be urged to join into various
mass organizations.
4) That the questions of non-payment of taxes,
increase of wages to juvenile farm hands and new laws and
better treatment be brought up for discussion among the
young masses and that meetings of farmers be convened to
discuss the starting of struggles of juvenile farmers.
5) That the workers of cotton mills, tobacco factories
and arsenals be instigated to participate in the strikes.
6) That cells be established in various industrial
concerns.
7) That the anti-Japanese imperialist and anti-
Manchukuo movements be strengthened.
8) That activities be conducted among the Japanese
soldiers.
9) That subscriptions be raised for the aid of the
red armies.
10) That the masses be urged to participate in the
commemoration of the anniversary of the October revolution.
11) That the picketing group and the Youth Vanguard
Corp at Shenyang should each detail two representatives to
visit the Soviet District.

The Mukden Special Committee
October 3.

Under the guidance of the inspection officer
of the "Central", the Fukien Special Committee has
seriously inspected the past errors which the Committee
committed in adopting the route of opportunism. The
Committee now decides:-
1) The Northern Conference clearly points two
worlds - the Capitalism and the Socialism of the Soviet
Union - and also two opposing regimes - the reactionary
Kuomintang Government and the Soviet Government. In
its intensified anti-imperialist movement, the Soviet
is opposing the attack on the Red Armies by the imperialistic
Kuomintang and is endeavouring to establish the Soviet
regime in the North.
2) The special Committee fully agrees with the
resolutions of the Provincial Committee to abolish the
opportunism. The Special Committee will henceforth
struggle for the establishment of the Soviet regime and
for the leadership of the racial revolution.
3) The special Committee will, with all its vigour,
execute the duties assigned by the Northern Conference,
namely:-
a) Support the Soviet Union with force of arms.
b) Oppose the attack of the imperialistic
Kuomintang on the Soviet and the Red Armies.
c) Intensify the racial revolutionary struggles.
d) Establish a Soviet regime and organise Red
Armies in the North.
e) Lead the strikes of the labourers of the
cotton mills, tobacco factories, etc.

Fukien Special Committee
July 29,

1) 北方会议明确指出两个世界——资本主义和苏联的社会主义——以及两个对立的政权——反动的国民党政府和苏维埃政府。在其强化的反帝运动中，苏维埃正反对帝国主义国民党对红军的进攻，并致力于在北方建立苏维埃政权。

3) 特别委员会将全力以赴执行北方会议分配的任务，即：-

b) 反对帝国主义国民党对苏维埃和红军的进攻。

1) That under the rising tide of the anti-
Japanese movement, the Special Committee should strengthen
its efforts to secure the leadership of the racial
revolution, to instigate Autumn Harvest struggles among
the farmers in Inoyang and to induce the youth volunteer
armies to fight against Japan.
2) To instigate the labour strikes in cotton
mills, tobacco factories, etc. and to secure the leadership
of the workers of the Mukden Coal Inc.
3) To accelerate the anti-militarist movement
by organizing youth volunteer armies, youth vanguard
corps and other armed forces to instigate mutinies among
the soldiers of the imperialists.
4) To support the Soviet Union and the Soviet
Red Army.
5) To extend the organization of the League by
establishing sections or cells in big cotton mills,
tobacco factories, especially among workers of the
Mukden Railway, the Mukden Tramway Company and the
Mukden Electricity Plant.
6) To restore the connections with outer regions
by establishing League branches in these districts.

Mukden Special Committee.

no. fc 5, zone 56, edhurat road, on February 1, 1933.

Resolutions of the Manchurian Provincial Committee
on Anti-Militarism Work.

The danger of war on the Soviet Union by
the Imperialists is approaching the critical stage,
while the partitioning of China and the suppression
of the Chinese revolution, especially the Red Armies
of the Soviet, by the Imperialists are taking place.
Nevertheless, the capitalistic Kuomintang has shamelessly
surrendered to the Imperialists and has betrayed the
privileges of the nation. Under the direct control
of the Imperialists, it is mobilising 50 Divisions of
soldiers in a campaign against the Red Armies in the
Soviet areas.

In the past the Communist Youth League in
Manchuria has neglected its activities among the
reactionary soldiers. The Japanese Imperialism is
using the armies of Manchukuo as tools for the suppression
of revolutionary movement.

Therefore it is considered necessary to execute
the following duties at the various places:-
1) To accelerate the work among the soldiers by
detailing comrades to join the ranks of the armies of
Manchukuo with a view to instigating these latter to
start mutinies.
2) To accelerate the work of arming the masses
and organizing youth vanguard corps and youth volunteers
among the juvenile workers in Mukden and Dairen. Induce
the juvenile farmers in the villages to join the movement.
3) To detail efficient comrades to join the
volunteer armies who are under the command of the
Kuomintang with a view to revealing to them the malice
and crimes of the Kuomintang and leading them to sever
from the militarists and to join the ranks of the
revolutionaries.
4) To conduct propaganda work among the Japanese
forces instigating them to mutiny.
5) To establish Anti-Imperialism Committees and
other similar bodies in various districts to carry out
the work.

Manchurian Provincial Committee
September 28.

满洲省委关于反军阀工作的决议。

帝国主义对苏联的战争危险正逼近关键阶段，而帝国主义正在瓜分中国并镇压中国革命，特别是镇压苏维埃的红军。然而，资本家的国民党无耻地向帝国主义投降，并出卖了国家特权。在帝国主义的直接控制下，它正调动50个师的兵力，在苏区开展针对红军的战役。

过去，满洲共产主义青年团忽视了在反动士兵中的活动。日本帝国主义正利用满洲国军队作为镇压革命运动的工具。

因此，认为有必要在各地执行以下任务：-
1) 通过派遣同志加入满洲国军队行列，加速在士兵中的工作，旨在煽动后者发动哗变。
2) 加速武装群众的工作，并在奉天和大连的青年工人中组织青年先锋队和青年义勇队。诱导农村的青年农民加入运动。
3) 派遣得力同志加入由国民党指挥的义勇军，旨在向他们揭露国民党的恶意和罪行，并引导他们与军阀决裂，加入革命者行列。
4) 在日军中进行宣传工作，煽动其哗变。
5) 在各地区建立反帝国主义委员会及其他类似机构，以开展此项工作。

满洲省委
9月28日。

WORK TO BE DONE BY THE YOUTH LEAGUE IN MANCHURIA

In connection with the work to extend
the racial war in Manchuria including the enforcement
of the Winter Storm Movement, the Communist Youth
League should endeavour to accomplish the following
concrete tasks:-
1) That the Communist Youth League in Manchuria
should detail 400 comrades to join the ranks of the
Volunteer armies.
2) That juvenile workers and farmers, especially
those of the Ta Tung Coal Mine, the Chinese Eastern Railway,
the Mukden Arsenal and unemployed workers and farmers in
Harbin, etc, be mobilized to form into volunteer corps.
3) That efforts be made to secure the control
of the various Volunteer Armies who are fighting against
the Japanese.
4) That sections be established in the Volunteer
Armies.
5) That a campaign of raising subscriptions for
the aid of the Volunteer Armies be conducted.
6) That propaganda be conducted among the
Japanese forces.
7) That juvenile workers and farmers be induced
to join the Volunteer Armies to participate in the racial
revolution.
8) That anti-Japanese Associations be established
in Harbin, Mukden, Changchun and Dairen.
9) That farmers and famine affected people be
guided to steal rice and to refuse to pay taxes.
10) That Soviet organizations be established
in various industrial concerns.
11) That the work to unite the toiling masses
of China, Korea and Mongolia be accelerated to oppose
the Japanese aggression.

Manchurian Provincial Committee
November 28,

结合包括实施“冬季风暴运动”在内的在满洲扩大民族战争的工作，共产主义青年团应努力完成以下具体任务：-

REPORT ON GENERAL SITUATION IN MANCHURIA

During the past six months the Manchurian
Embroglio has been developing greatly. In an attempt
to materialize her occupation of Manchuria, Japan is
invading Inner and Outer Mongolia and is establishing
battle lines for the direct war on the Soviet Union.
Since January 1932 Japanese Imperialists have instigated
the White Russians to start riots in Harbin and instructed
General Tsang Chin, Wei to reorganize military organs and
to suppress press publication and all people's anti-
Japanese movement.
The Japanese Imperialists are behaving recklessly
in Manchuria and in cooperation with the French Imperialists
she is endeavouring to secure control of the Chinese
Eastern Railway. She has massacred workers and employees
of the Chinese Eastern Railway and attempted to break the
peace policy of the Soviet Union.
The vast masses of juvenile workers and farmers
in Manchuria are suffering extreme misery and oppressions
under the positive aggression of the Japanese Imperialists.
They are now either ill-treated or rendered destitute and
homeless.
In order to secure the leadership of these
affected toiling masses, the League should understand
their urgent demands and sympathize with them. The
League should organize Red Labour Union or Red Sections
and form youth volunteer corps. The League should
pay attention to the female workers.
Activities should be conducted among the
"Big Sword Club", "Red Spear Club", etc. with a view
to arming them and training them for the purpose of
assisting the poor labourers and peasants in the theft
of rice and the commission of incendiarism. All lands
and property of the officials of Manchukuo should be
confiscated and divided among the peasants and volunteer
corps.

the workers of various industrial concerns:-

满洲局势总报告

过去六个月中，满洲事变事态发展巨大。日本为实现其占领满洲的目的，正入侵内蒙古和外蒙古，并为直接对苏联作战建立战线。自1932年1月以来，日本帝国主义者煽动白俄在哈尔滨发动骚乱，并指令臧真（Tsang Chin, Wei，音译）将军重组军事机构，压制新闻出版及一切民众的反日运动。

日本帝国主义者在满洲行为鲁莽，并与法国帝国主义者合作，企图控制中东铁路。他们屠杀中东铁路的工人和职员，并试图破坏苏联的和平政策。

在日本帝国主义者的积极侵略下，满洲广大的青年工人和农民遭受极度的苦难和压迫。他们现在要么受到虐待，要么变得贫困潦倒、无家可归。

为了确立对这些受影响的劳苦大众的领导，青年团应了解他们的迫切需求并对他们表示同情。青年团应组织赤色工会或赤色小组，并组建青年志愿队。青年团应注意女工工作。

应在“大刀会”、“红枪会”等组织中开展活动，目的是武装并训练他们，以协助贫苦劳工和农民进行偷米和纵火活动。应没收伪满洲国官员的所有土地和财产，并分给农民和志愿队。

REPORT ON INSPECTION OF MANCHURIA.

"Central":

This is my fifth report on the inspection
of the activities of the Manchurian Provincial Committee.
I trust my four previous reports have duly reached you.

The Provincial Committee has accepted the
resolutions passed by the Northern Conference and is
at present re-embarking on the route of the "Central".
The work which it has performed has shown slight progress
and development.

1) Preparation of the organization and leadership
of the strikes of workers of printing works, aerodromes
and work shops of the Chinese Eastern Railway.

Prior to "August 1", the workers of four
printing works in Harbin went on strike. The total
number of workers affected was about 150. All these
strikes were directed by the Party and the League. The
strikers demanded: "Opposition to dismissal of workers",
"Increase of pay", "Opposition to prolongation of working
hours", etc.

There are more than 2,000 Chinese workers and
300 Korean workers employed at the aerodrome. The
Chinese workers do not receive any pay but are provided
with rations. On the anniversary of "August 1", 40
Chinese workers declared a strike and induced the 300
Korean workers to join the movement. They surrounded
the superintendent of the aerodrome who later granted
certain concessions which satisfied the strikers. This
movement was led by the League single-handed.

Due to the efforts of the League, much unrest
is prevailing among the juvenile workers, drivers and
conductors of the electricity plant of the Chinese
Eastern Railway. The workers are demanding "increase
of pay", "bonus", "usual pay on holidays", etc.

2) Establishment of sections in industrial concerns

During the "August 1" movement, a large section
of 13 members was established in the electricity plant,
while sections were also established in iron works, docks,
and other industrial concerns.

3) Support of the Red Army

The Provincial Committee has accepted the decisions
of the "Central" for the support of the Red Army. In this
connection the Committee published a printing matter entitled
"Red Army Special Issue". The Committee also made out a
very interesting slogan for the workers of the electricity
plant - "Donate 10 cash each for the subscription to the
Red Army". Demand to raise subscriptions was then on
foot among students and various of the citizens.

满洲视察报告。

“中央”：

这是我关于视察满洲省委活动的第五份报告。我相信我之前的四份报告已 duly 送达贵处。

省委已接受北方会议通过的决议，目前正重新踏上“中央”的路线。其所做工作显示出轻微的进步和发展。

1) 准备组织和领导印刷厂、飞机场和中东铁路车间工人的罢工。

在“八一”之前，哈尔滨四家印刷厂的工人举行了罢工。受影响工人总数约为150人。所有这些罢工均由党和青年团指导。罢工者要求：“反对解雇工人”、“增加工资”、“反对延长工作时间”等。

飞机场雇有2,000多名中国工人和300名朝鲜工人。中国工人不领取任何工资，但提供口粮。在“八一”纪念日，40名中国工人宣布罢工，并促使300名朝鲜工人加入运动。他们包围了飞机场主管，后者随后给予某些让步，满足了罢工者的要求。这次运动由青年团单独领导。

由于青年团的努力，中东铁路电厂的青年工人、司机和售票员中存在很大的不安情绪。工人们要求“增加工资”、“奖金”、“节假日照常发薪”等。

2) 在工业企业中建立小组

在“八一”运动期间，电厂建立了一个拥有13名成员的大型小组，同时在铁厂、码头和其他工业企业中也建立了小组。

3) 支援红军

省委已接受“中央”关于支援红军的决定。为此，委员会出版了一份名为《红军特刊》的印刷品。委员会还为电厂工人制定了一个非常有趣的口号——“每人捐款十文用于认购红军债券”。随后在学生和各界市民中开展了募集认购的活动。

Work done during the past 6 month

Shensi was affected by famine during the past years
and thousands and thousands of farmers are still
homeless. They have either become beggars in other
provinces or joined the troops in Shensi or become
bandits. Owing to the failure of the summer harvest in
this year (? 1932), the farmers and refugees in Si Chuan
district are now eating grass and the bark of trees, all t
the territory in Western Shensi is in devastated conditions.
In addition to famine, the people are more heavily
oppressed by militarists, corrupt gentry, and landlords.
Despite the existence of dissensions among themselves,
the Shensi militarists are united in suppressing the
revolutionary movements of the masses. One worker
was arrested and detained simply because he picked up
a manifesto issued by the Communist Youth League and
another was killed for committing sabotage at an amateur
players club or utilized by a regimental commander. Many
farmers in Wei Poh who took part in the food distribution
movement were murdered, and massacre of students is also
frequent. Nevertheless, the revolutionary movement
continues to grow, and the rule of the Kuomintang
militarists is shaken.

The following are facts:-
(1) Mass struggles have become popular. Workers have
demanded increase of pay and attacked the amateur
players club of the militarists; the peasants of
more than 40 'Hsiens' have conducted a movement to
distribute food and besieged walled cities; students
have declared a general strike; small merchants
are opposing the business tax and the employees of
industrial concerns and official organs are opposing
dismissal and reduction of pay.
(2) Desertion and revolt often happen in the Kuomintang
armies throughout Shensi.
(3) Every part of Shensi is full of bandits and the
Kuomintang troops can hardly maintain order.

The following is a statistics of comrades in Shensi:-
Young workers and apprentices: 9
Peasants : 180(approximately).
Nurses : 8
Students : 158(approximately).
Employees : 4
Miscellaneous : 26
Total 385 ---this figure does not
include those in guerrillas and regular armies.

The following is a statistics of branches in Shansi:
Factory branch : 1
Village branch : 20
School branch : 14
Mutual Aid Society : 7

Two parties of youth vanguards consisting of 70 or
80 persons are assisting Red Armies in guerrilla attacks.

1933年2月1日于巴瑟斯特路（Bathurst Road）56弄PC 6号搜获的涉及陕西共产主义活动的(a)号文件（证据编号7）译文。

小册子题为《杨同志关于陕西共产主义青年团状况和工作的报告》。

过去6个月所做的工作

陕西在过去几年遭受饥荒影响，成千上万的农民仍然无家可归。他们要么成为其他省份的乞丐，要么加入陕西的军队，要么成为土匪。由于今年（？1932年）夏收失败，四川地区的农民和难民现在正在吃草和树皮，陕西西部全境处于荒芜状态。除了饥荒，人民还受到军阀、腐败士绅和地主更沉重的压迫。尽管陕西军阀内部存在分歧，但他们联合起来镇压群众的革命运动。一名工人仅因拾获一份共产主义青年团发布的宣言而被捕拘留，另一名工人则因在业余剧社进行破坏活动或被团长利用而被杀。渭泊（Wei Poh，音译）许多参加分粮运动的农民被谋杀，学生遭屠杀的事件也频繁发生。尽管如此，革命运动继续增长，国民党军阀的统治受到动摇。

事实如下：
(1) 群众斗争已变得普遍。工人要求增加工资并攻击军阀的业余剧社；40多个“县”的农民开展了分粮运动并包围城墙城市；学生宣布总罢工；小商人反对营业税，工业企业和官方机构的雇员反对解雇和减薪。
(2) 整个陕西的国民党军队中经常发生逃兵和叛变。
(3) 陕西各地匪患严重，国民党军队难以维持秩序。

Translation of document (b), Exhibit No. 7, bearing on
communist activities in Shensi, seized from No. Fe 8,

Pamphlet entitled "Resolutions of the Communist
Youth League in Shensi "in connection with student
movements.".

The students of various schools in Shensi are
struggling against the Kuomintang and other reactionary
cliques, but they are in need of guidance and solid
organization in order to extend their movement with
successful results. They have failed to realize
the importance of strikes which they should use as
a weapon against their opponents. Consequently the
Communist Party and the Communist Youth League should
accelerate their work among the students.

The general principles of the student movements in
Shensi should include the following:-
(1) Opposition to the new attacks upon China by the
Japanese imperialists and the proposed partition
of China by various imperialistic Powers.
(2) Opposition to the 'sale' of national rights by the
Kuomintang and the anti-communist campaign.
(3) Opposition to the arrest of revolutionary students.
(4) Demand the release of arrested students.
(5) Opposition to the suppression of the anti-Japanese
movement by the Kuomintang.
(6) Opposition to the activities of all reactionary
cliques liable to harm the anti-Japanese movements
(7) Opposition to the enforcement of 'Fascistized education'
and the illegal besiege of school premises for
arresting students.
(8) Opposition to the preaching of the Kuomintang
principles in schools, and refusal to attend the
weekly memorials of the Kuomintang.
(9) Opposition to the use of educational funds for other
purposes.
(10) Opposition to the use of educational funds for
attacking Red Armies.
(11) Expulsion of reactionary teachers and staff. Absolute
freedom to choose teachers.
(12) Freedom of assembly, speech, publication, and strike.

The Communist Party and the Communist Youth League
should at once organize revolutionary students unions
consisting of students of poor families and those who
entertain revolutionary thoughts. Revolutionary
students unions are to undertake the following activities:-
(1) Apart from directing the struggles of students, the
revolutionary student union should also direct various
student organizations such as social science research
societies, sports clubs, and book-reading clubs etc.
(2) The revolutionary student union should promote strikes,
organize picketing parties and propaganda parties, and
devise ways and means to extend the strike.
(3) In a strike of students, efforts should be made to
hold demonstrations, to besiege the military court
of the provincial government, and to hold 'flying'
meetings to force the demand for the release of
arrested students.
(4) Anti-Japanese and Anti-Imperialist movements are
to be conducted as rapidly as possible attaching
special attention to the propaganda in support of
Red Armies and the Soviet movement in China.

小册子题为《陕西共产主义青年团关于学生运动的决议》。

陕西各校学生正在与国民党及其他反动派系作斗争，但他们需要指导和严密的组织，以便将其运动推向成功。他们尚未认识到罢工的重要性，而罢工本应作为对抗对手的武器。因此，共产党和共产主义青年团应加速在学生中的工作。

陕西学生运动的一般原则应包括以下内容：
(1) 反对日本帝国主义对中国的新的攻击，以及各帝国主义列强瓜分中国的图谋。
(2) 反对国民党“出卖”国家权利及反共运动。
(3) 反对逮捕革命学生。
(4) 要求释放被捕学生。
(5) 反对国民党镇压抗日运动。
(6) 反对所有可能损害抗日运动的反动派系的活动。
(7) 反对推行“法西斯化教育”以及非法包围校舍以逮捕学生。
(8) 反对在学校宣讲国民党主义，并拒绝参加每周的国民党纪念活动。
(9) 反对将教育经费挪作他用。
(10) 反对使用教育经费进攻红军。
(11) 驱逐反动教员和职员。拥有选择教员的绝对自由。
(12) 集会、言论、出版和罢工的自由。

共产党和共产主义青年团应立即组织由贫困家庭学生和具有革命思想的学生组成的革命学生会。革命学生会应承担以下活动：
(1) 除了指导学生的斗争外，革命学生会还应指导各种学生组织，如社会科学研究会、体育俱乐部和读书会等。
(2) 革命学生会应推动罢工，组织纠察队和宣传队，并设法扩大罢工。
(3) 在学生罢工期间，应努力举行示威，包围省政府军事法庭，并举行“飞行”集会，以迫使当局释放被捕学生。
(4) 应尽快开展抗日和反帝运动，特别注意进行宣传以支持红军和中国的苏维埃运动。

Report from Shensi bearing on the International Youth
Day Movement and the conditions of work of the Communist
Youth League in Shensi.

Work done by the Shensi Provincial Committee on the
anniversary of the International Youth Day:-

(1) Direction of labour struggles.
(a) On August 24, 1932, the Shensi Bus Company dismissed
60 workers and more than 20 apprentices and refused
to pay the other workers and apprentices the four
months' wages in arrear. The workers and
apprentices subsequently besieged the offices of the
company and appealed to the Construction Bureau on
their own initiative for neither the Communist Party
nor the Communist Youth League has any direct
connection with the bus workers. Shortly afterwards
the Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth
League mobilised the union of apprentices, the
Mutual Aid Society of Engineering Works, and the
anti-Japanese societies of various schools to support
the strike which was made victorious.
(b) After the struggle of the bus workers, the
Printing Bureau dismissed 29 workers. The Communist
Youth League was unable to exploit this incident as
the dismissed workers returned home immediately after
their dismissal.
(c) The capitalists of the Civilisation Daily News
increased the working hours and supplied inferior
food. The section established among the workers
directed the struggle but failed to bring about
any good result.
(d) The workers of the Sian Engineering Works
demanded better treatment and our comrades directed
the struggle. However, the principal comrades
were arrested on the anniversary of the International
Youth Day and the struggle finally failed.

(2) Work to support Soviet and Red Armies.
Collected contributions for the support of Red
Armies, sent two students to Soviet areas, , and
organised a Red Army Friendly Society.

(3) Work to support the anti-imperialist movement.
Nothing done other than propaganda work.

(4) Flying meetings and demonstrations on the International
Youth Day failed to materialise owing to vigilant
precautionary measures taken by the military and
police.

(5) The Provincial Committee has organised an anti-
militarism committee and established 3 sections
among 'white' troops at Sian.

来自陕西的报告，涉及国际青年日运动及陕西共产主义青年团的工作状况。

陕西省委在国际青年日纪念日所做的工作：

(1) 指导劳工斗争。
(a) 1932年8月24日，陕西公共汽车公司解雇了60名工人和20多名学徒，并拒绝支付其他工人和学徒拖欠的四个月工资。随后，工人和学徒包围了公司办公室，并主动向建设局申诉，因为共产党和共产主义青年团都与公交车工人没有直接联系。不久之后，共产主义青年团省委动员了学徒工会、工程互助社和各校抗日社团支持罢工，使罢工取得胜利。
(b) 在公交车工人斗争之后，印刷局解雇了29名工人。共产主义青年团未能利用这一事件，因为被解雇的工人在被解雇后立即回家了。
(c) 《文明日报》的资本家增加了工作时间并供应劣质食物。在工人中建立的支部指导了这场斗争，但未能取得任何良好结果。
(d) 西安工程厂的工人要求改善待遇，我们的同志指导了这场斗争。然而，主要同志在国际青年日纪念日被捕，斗争最终失败。

(2) 支持苏维埃和红军的工作。
募集支持红军的捐款，派遣两名学生前往苏区，并组织了一个红军之友社。

(3) 支持反帝运动的工作。
除宣传工作外，未做任何其他事情。

(4) 由于军方和警方采取了警惕的预防措施，国际青年日的飞行集会和示威未能实现。

(5) 省委已组织一个反军国主义委员会，并在西安的“白军”中建立了3个支部。

Translation of document (a) Exhibit No. 14, seized

Letter to Branch of Central Headquarters (Communist
Youth League) in Soviet Districts.
----

Comrades,

After reading the report of XXX, the documents
relating to the 1st General Conference of Representatives
of League members in Soviet Districts, and the articles
written by responsible comrades as published in the
"Youth True Talk", we deem it necessary to send you this
letter. ............
In view of the present situation, the Branch of
Central Headquarters of Communist Youth League and other
C.Y. organizations in Soviet Districts should undertake
the following tasks:-
1) The consolidation of the Soviet rule is one of the
principal duties of the Communist Youth League in
Soviet Districts. The League should mobilise large
numbers of young labourers, peasants and poor masses
to support the Soviet Government and explain to them
the Labour Laws, Land Regulations, Constitutions and
manifestoes of the Soviet Government. It should
conduct struggles in order to enforce these laws
and orders, execute the accurate economic policies
of the Soviet Government, assist in the enforcement
of progressive tax, develop cooperative societies,
and promote agriculture.
2) The Branch of Central Headquarters of Communist Youth
League in Soviet Districts should, in accordance with
the resolutions of the Central, send large numbers
of poor masses, young labourers and peasants to join
Red Armies and collect contributions for supporting
the Red Armies.
3) The Branch of Central Headquarters should explain
to the masses that the Red Armies are the genuine
anti-Imperialist forces, and disseminate in large
quantities copies of the manifesto of the Soviet
Government declaring war upon Japan. The Branch
should also draft plans to carry out anti-imperialist
movements in 'White' districts.
4) The Branch should endeavour to improve the living
conditions of labouring youths in Soviet Districts.
5) The Branch should endeavour to absorb large numbers
of labouring youths into the Communist Youth League
and consolidate the proletarian leadership in order
to prevent the creation of opportunism.
6) The Branch should now improve its propaganda work
and pay special attention to "Red" education.
7) The Branch should enforce strictly the resolutions
of the Central in connection with the Winter Campaign.
In conclusion, the Branch should concentrate its
attention on the suppression of opportunism and on
directing the numerous young labouring and poor masses
in realizing revolutionary victory in one or several
provinces.

Central of the C. Y. League,
June 8, 1934.

致苏区中央总部（共产主义青年团）分支机构的信。
----

同志们，

在阅读了XXX的报告、有关苏区团员第一次代表大会的文件以及负责同志发表在《青年真话》上的文章后，我们认为有必要给你们写这封信。 ............
鉴于当前形势，苏区共产主义青年团中央总部分支机构及其他共青团组织应承担以下任务：
1) 巩固苏维埃政权是苏区共产主义青年团的主要职责之一。共青团应动员大量青年工人、农民和贫苦群众支持苏维埃政府，并向他们解释苏维埃政府的劳动法、土地条例、宪法和宣言。它应开展斗争以执行这些法律和命令，贯彻苏维埃政府准确的经济政策，协助征收累进税，发展合作社，并促进农业发展。
2) 苏区共产主义青年团中央总部分支机构应根据中央的决议，派遣大量贫苦群众、青年工人和农民加入红军，并募集捐款以支持红军。
3) 中央总部分支机构应向群众解释，红军是真正的反帝力量，并大量散发苏维埃政府对日宣战宣言的副本。该分支机构还应起草计划在“白区”开展反帝运动。
4) 分支机构应努力改善苏区劳动青年的生活条件。
5) 分支机构应努力吸收大量劳动青年加入共产主义青年团，并巩固无产阶级领导权，以防止机会主义的产生。
6) 分支机构现在应改进其宣传工作，并特别注意“红色”教育。
7) 分支机构应严格执行中央关于冬季战役的决议。
总之，分支机构应集中注意力镇压机会主义，并指导广大青年劳动群众和贫苦群众在一个或几个省份实现革命胜利。

共青团中央，
1934年6月8日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. REGISTRY. No. D 4454 Special Branch - S.2. Station / Date 15 / 2 / 33 February 15. 1933.）

Subject (in full) Memorandum on the conduct of the representatives of the
Chinese Authorities functioning at House 5, Lane 56 Meihurst
Road on February 1, 1933.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [签名]

Shortly after 3.30 p.m. February 1, 1933, members of the
Bubbling Well Police Station answering an alarm call, pro-
ceeded to House No. 5, Lane 56, Meihurst Road, where it was
ascertained that Inspector Lieu Kuh Jing ( 呂 克 勤 ) of
the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety in company with other
Chinese males, had entered the premises, had effected the
arrest of two male and one female Chinese Communists and in
doing so, had seriously assaulted the two former persons. A
search of the premises by the Municipal Police unearthed a
quantity of important communist documents.

Inspector Lieu stated that together with his informer
Zung Ping Woo ( 陳 炳 和 ) (arrested in the Kiochow Road
case on 18.11.1932) he had followed the two male prisoners
whom he knew to be very important communists to the above
mentioned address, and that whilst making enquiries regard-
ing the occupants of the house he was attacked and dragged
into the premises by the two prisoners, with the result that
he was forced to resist in order to protect himself.

The importance of arresting at the earliest possible
moment Wong Yoong Zung ( 王 雲 程 ) and Sung Chi Ming
( 孫 際 明 ), respectively Secretary and Chief of the
Organisation Department of the Communist Youth League,
seems to have caused the Public Safety Bureau Officials to
neglect adopting the correct procedure of invoking the
assistance of the Municipal Police, but on the other hand,
had this been done a certain delay would have necessarily
been occasioned, and the possibility of the suspects making
good their escape is evident.

In October or November of last year, Sung Chi Ming was

主题（全称） 关于1933年2月1日在中国当局代表于麦赫斯特路56弄5号活动的行为的备忘录。
制作人 D.S. Pitts。 转发人 [签名]

1933年2月1日下午3点30分过后不久，静安寺警署成员响应报警电话，前往麦赫斯特路56弄5号，经查实，上海公安局督察吕克勤（Lieu Kuh Jing）与其他几名中国男子进入该处所，逮捕了两名男性和一名女性中国共产党员，在此过程中严重殴打了前两名男性。工部局警察对该处所进行搜查，发现了大量重要的共产党文件。

吕督察称，他与线人陈炳和（Zung Ping Woo）（在1932年11月18日的胶州路案件中被捕）一起，跟踪两名他已知为重要共产党员的男囚犯至上述地址，在询问屋内居住者时遭到两名囚犯攻击并被拖入屋内，导致他被迫自卫抵抗。

尽早逮捕共青团书记王云程（Wong Yoong Zung）和组织部长孙际明（Sung Chi Ming）的重要性，似乎导致公安局官员忽视了请求工部局警务处协助的正确程序；但另一方面，如果这样做必然会造成一定延误，嫌疑人趁机逃脱的可能性显而易见。

With reference to the attached file relating to the arrest of Tseng Han Ching (張漢卿) alias Wong Yoong Zung (王雲程) and Wong Seu Su (黃守素) alias Sung Chi Ming at No.5, Lane 56 Medhurst Road, On February 1, 1933, The prisoner Tsang Han Ching alias Wong Yoong Zung was further interrogated by the undersigned and Clerk Zung Zoong Oen on February 11 when the following information regarding members of the Communist Party was obtained:-

Sung Chi Ming (孫際明):
Sung Chi Ming attended the Chung Shang University, Moscow, between March 1928 and the spring of 1929. He then left Moscow with Hsiang Hsoong Fah (向忠發) and several other students for Germany and Belgium where they worked as interpreters with the Anti-Imperialist League. Returning to Moscow (alone) in the summer of 1929 he resumed his studies at the university. In the summer of 1931 he proceeded to Shanghai and was appointed "Clerk" of the Shanghai Western District Committee of the Communist Youth League. In May 1932 he was promoted "Clerk" of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the C.Y.L. and held this position until July 1932 when he was again promoted to the post of "Chief" of the Organization Department of the C.Y.L. which position he was holding at the time of his arrest - February 1, 1933.
In Moscow he is known by the name "Karloloff."
Sung Chi Ming's elder brother, Sung Shioh Seu (孫曉初), is the Shanghai representative of the 24th Szechuen Army. He resides at No.5 Yih Tuh Li (億德里), Rue Lafayette, French Concession. Although he is a member of the Communist Party he is inactive.

孙际明（Sung Chi Ming）：
孙际明于1928年3月至1929年春季期间在莫斯科中山大学就读。随后他与向忠发（Hsiang Hsoong Fah）及其他几名学生离开莫斯科前往德国和比利时，在那里担任反帝同盟的口译员。1929年夏他独自返回莫斯科，继续在大学学习。1931年夏他前往上海，被任命为共青团上海西区委员会“文书”。1932年5月，他晋升为共青团江苏省委“文书”，并担任此职直至1932年7月，当时他再次晋升为共青团组织部“部长”，被捕时（1933年2月1日）正担任此职。
在莫斯科，他的名字是“卡尔洛夫”（Karloloff）。
孙际明的哥哥孙晓初（Sung Shioh Seu），是川军第二十四军的上海代表。他居住在法租界拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）亿德里5号。虽然他是共产党员，但不活跃。

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 11.2.33.

Arrest and Extradition of Important members of the
Communist Youth League.

Two Chinese named Tsang Han Ching (張漢卿) alias Wong Yoong
Zung (王永城) and Wong Seu Su (黃守素) alias Sung Chih Ming
(孫志明), who are known to be the secretary of the Communis-
Youth League and the Chief of the Organization Department of
the Communist Youth League respectively, were brought on Feb. 9
before the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court which made an
order to have them handed over to the Chinese Authorities.
These men were arrested on February 1 in a room used as the
Central Headquarters of the Communist Youth League situated
at No.5, Lane 56 Medhurst Road, where a search made by the
Police resulted in the discovery of 69 documents and 68 different
kinds of leaflets and other literature advocating communism.
The documents related to communist activities in China and
included reports on the progress of the movement in Kiangsi,
Kiangsu, Hunan, Hupeh, Fukien, Kwangtung, Szechuen, Shantung
and Manchuria.
The evidence presented in support of the charge showed
that the accused joined the Communist Party about 1926 and
subsequently were educated and trained as Communist propagandists
in Moscow. Wong Seu Su alias Sung Chi Ming has a thorough
knowledge of Chinese, Russian and English while Tsang Han
Ching alias Wong Yoong Zung knows Russian and Chinese.

共产主义青年团重要成员的逮捕与引渡。

两名华人，名为张汉卿 (Tsang Han Ching)，化名王永城 (Wong Yoong Zung)；以及黄守素 (Wong Seu Su)，化名孙志明 (Sung Chih Ming)，据知分别为共产主义青年团书记和共产主义青年团组织部部长，于2月9日被提审至江苏高等法院第二分院，该院下令将他们移交给中国当局。
这些人于2月1日在麦特赫司脱路56弄5号的一个房间内被捕，该房间被用作共产主义青年团中央总部，警方在此搜查中发现了69份文件以及68种不同种类的宣传共产主义的传单和其他文献。
这些文件涉及在中国的共产主义活动，包括关于江西、江苏、湖南、湖北、福建、广东、四川、山东和满洲等地运动进展的报告。
支持指控的证据显示，被告约于1926年加入共产党，随后在莫斯科接受教育并受训成为共产主义宣传员。黄守素化名孙志明，精通中文、俄文和英文；而张汉卿化名王永城，通晓俄文和中文。

February 9 3.

Dear

I have to inform you that two Chinese named Wong
Yong Zung alias Tsang Han Ching and Wong Scu Su alias
Wong Shao Yang alias Sung Tsi Ming, who are alleged to
be the Secretary of the Communist Youth League and Chief
of the Organization Department of the Chinese Communist
Youth League respectively, were arrested at No 5, Lane 56,
Medhurst Road, on February 1, 1933.

I forward herewith for your information a list of
the documents found at the place where the arrest was effected,
a statement made by Wong Yong Zung alias Tsang Han Ching,
and translations of the documents bearing the serial numbers
5"A" and 15"G".

If you will kindly send me a note giving the serial
numbers of documents which you consider important, I shall
arrange to obtain in English an account either in full or
summarized form of all information they contain which is
likely to be of interest.

I shall be thankful if you will send the note
requested as early as possible, as the documents belong
to the Chinese Authorities and will leave the possession
of the Municipal Police in a few days.

Yours sincerely,

H. H. Stephens Esq
Capt. B. P. Birler
page_data.zh:
1933年2月9日。

亲爱的先生：

兹通知您，两名中国人黄永宗（又名曾汉清）和黄树苏（又名黄少阳，又名宋子明），据称分别担任共产主义青年团书记和中国共产主义青年团组织部部长，于1933年2月1日在麦赫斯特路56弄5号被捕。

现随函附上在逮捕地点查获的文件清单、黄永宗（又名曾汉清）所作的陈述，以及编号为5“A”和15“G”的文件的译文，供贵方参考。

如蒙惠示一份注明贵方认为重要的文件编号的便条，我将安排以全文或摘要形式获取其中可能引起关注的所有信息的英文报告。

如能尽早发来所求便条，不胜感激，因为这些文件属于中国当局所有，将在数日内移交警务处保管之外。

此致
敬礼，

H. H. Stephens 先生
B. P. Birler 上尉

page_data.en:
王永城印
（王雲程）
汪明栋
D.S. Pitts and D.S. Tilton.
Hankow, Hupeh
Feb. 6, 1930.
Clerk Zung.

My name is Ong Yoong Zung (王雲程即王永城; alias Jong Sing
ung (汪明栋), aged 26, native of Hankow, Hupeh, married,
coolie by profession.
I first studied at a primary school in Hankow when I was
seven years of age and remained there until I was eleven. I
learned to read and write whilst there. After leaving this
school I commenced working as an apprentice at the Kau Tai
(保泰油店) Oil Shop, Hankow where I stayed for two
years. Leaving this position I made my way to the Chu Ma Tien
(駐馬店), Honan, in order to work as a coolie in the
Yuen Fong (元丰蛋廠) Egg Factory. I remained here for
two years.
Leaving here I went to Hankow and worked as a coolie in
the Hwo Jien (和记蛋廠) Egg Factory - a British concern. My
salary in this post was $5 per month and I stayed here for two
years. After this I managed to obtain a job as an apprentice
in the Hwo Fong (華丰) Cloth Factory in Hankow. I
served two years apprenticeship, afterwards becoming a worker.
Altogether I stayed here for three years.
Through the recommendation of a fellow-countryman named
Yi Ts Ching (易志卿), I obtained a position as a coolie
in the Tuh Ming (德明) Hotel, Hankow, my wages being $9.
I worked here until the end of 1928.
Whilst on night duty in this hotel, I spent my days study-
ing at a Labourers' School in Hankow, where revolutionary ideas
were instilled in my mind. Consequently, believing these
doctrines, I joined the Communist Party, but this was kept
page_data.zh:
王永城印
（王雲程）
汪明栋
D.S. Pitts 和 D.S. Tilton。
湖北汉口
1930年2月6日。
书记员 Zung。

我叫 Ong Yoong Zung（王雲程即王永城；别名 Jong Sing ung (汪明栋)），26岁，湖北汉口人，已婚，职业为苦力。
我七岁时开始在汉口的一所小学读书，一直读到十一岁。在那里我学会了读写。离开这所学校后，我开始在汉口的 Kau Tai (保泰油店) 油店当学徒，在那里待了两年。离开该职位后，我前往河南 Chu Ma Tien (駐馬店)，在 Yuen Fong (元丰蛋廠) 蛋厂做苦力。我在这里待了两年。
离开那里后，我去了汉口，在 Hwo Jien (和记蛋廠) 蛋厂——一家英国公司——做苦力。我在这个职位上的薪水是每月5元，我在这里待了两年。之后，我在汉口的 Hwo Fong (華丰) 布厂找到了一份学徒工作。我做了两年学徒，随后成为正式工人。我在这里总共待了三年。
通过一位名叫 Yi Ts Ching (易志卿) 的同乡推荐，我在汉口的 Tuh Ming (德明) 酒店获得了一份苦力工作，工资为9元。我在这里工作直到1928年底。
在这家酒店值夜班时，我白天在汉口的一所劳工学校学习，在那里我的头脑中被灌输了革命思想。因此，信奉这些学说后，我加入了共产党，但这被保密

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the rupture between the Communist and Kuomintang Parties.

In March 1927, I came to Shanghai with the object of
proceeding to Moscow, but I was unable to make
any connection with the Party here until December 1927, when
45 other young students and members of the Communist Party, I
left for Vladivostock by the s.s. Pingwo. We stayed in Vlad-
ivostock for one month before proceeding to Moscow, where I
studied at the Sun Yat Sen University until the end of 1931,
when I was ordered to return to Shanghai to work with the
Chinese Communist Party. I travelled via Manchuria and
arrived in Shanghai at the end of December, 1931.

I stayed in various hotels in Shanghai after my arrival,
until the end of January 1932, paying my expenses with G$20,
which was given to me by the Communist Party before I left
Russia.

At the beginning of February, acting on instructions given
by the Communist Party in Russia, I got into touch with agents
of the Communist Party in China, who were residing at a lodg-
ing House the whereabouts of which I do not remember.

I received instructions from one Lo Ting Yien (羅定賢)
a Cantonese clerk in the National Labour Federation to work with
that Society, whose H.Qs were at that time situated at Tai
Oen Li (泰安里), North Honan Road. Lo is at present
working as a Communist Inspector in Manchuria.

It was at this time that I met Sung Chi Ming (宋志明)
the Chief of the Organisation Department of the Communist
Youth League. Sung was trained in Russia and can speak
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

直至国共两党破裂。

1927年3月，我来到上海，目的是前往莫斯科，但直到1927年12月我才在这里与党组织取得联系，当时我和其他45名年轻学生及共产党员一起，乘坐“平沃”号轮船（s.s. Pingwo）前往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。我们在符拉迪沃斯托克停留了一个月，然后前往莫斯科，我在那里在中山大学学习，直到1931年底，当时我被命令返回上海，为中国共产党工作。我经由满洲旅行，于1931年12月底抵达上海。

抵达上海后，我住在各家旅馆，直到1932年1月底，花费了共产党在我离开俄罗斯前给我的20金元支付开销。

2月初，根据共产党在俄罗斯发出的指示，我与居住在一处寄宿公寓的中国共产党代理人取得了联系，该公寓的具体位置我已不记得。

我从全国总工会的一位广东籍书记员 Lo Ting Yien (羅定賢) 那里接受指示，在该协会工作，其总部当时位于北河南路 Tai Oen Li (泰安里)。Lo 目前在满洲担任共产党视察员。

就在此时，我遇到了宋志明 (Sung Chi Ming)，他是共产主义青年团组织部主任。宋在俄罗斯受过训练，能说

page_data.en:
- 3 -

and write English and Russian perfectly well.
At about the same time, instructions were received from
the Communist Party to proceed to a certain foreign house on
Bubbling Well Road near Gordon Road. I went with So Ting
Yien and an interpreter, and after meeting the foreigner we
discussed the many phases of communism in all its branches. The
foreigner also gave us instructions as to how to act. One of
the photographs that you have just shown to me I definitely
recognise as the foreigner I then met. (NOTE: Six photo-
graphs of known or suspected foreign communists were shown to
the prisoner and he unhesitatingly picked out the photograph
of V. ROVER as the man he met at the house on Bubbling Well
Road.)

This man's description is as follows:-
Over 30 years of age, about 5'8" in height, stout build,
dark wavy hair short at the back, wears glasses, good teeth
at the front, broad round face, with a mole on I believe the
right cheek, high forehead, dark eyebrows, big mouth, wears
glasses, hairy hands, speaks English and Russian, dark shaven.
Sometimes carries a walking stick and is smartly dressed.

After being affiliated to the National Labour Federation
of which I was Chief of the Organisation Department, I was
transferred to the Shanghai Labour Union, a lower grade of
the former Federation, with its offices in a house on Peking
Road, the number of which I do not remember. My position here
was "Acting Clerk" the original clerk having been arrested.
I remained in this capacity for six weeks after which
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

写流利的英语和俄语。
大约在同一时间，收到共产党的指示，前往静安寺路靠近戈登路的一处外国人的住宅。我和 So Ting Yien 以及一名翻译一同前往，在与该外国人会面后，我们讨论了共产主义各个分支的许多方面。该外国人还就如何行动向我们发出了指示。你刚才给我看的照片中，我明确认出其中一张就是我当时遇到的那个外国人。（注：向囚犯展示了六张已知或疑似外国共产党员的照片，他毫不犹豫地挑出了 V. ROVER 的照片，称其为他在静安寺路那所房子里遇到的人。）

此人的体貌特征如下：
30多岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，体格粗壮，深色卷发，后脑勺头发较短，戴眼镜，前牙良好，宽圆脸，我相信右脸颊上有一颗痣，高额头，浓眉，大嘴，戴眼镜，手毛较多，讲英语和俄语，面部刮得干净。有时携带手杖，衣着整洁。

在隶属于全国总工会（我担任组织部主任）之后，我被调往上海工会联合会，这是前联合会的一个下级组织，其办公室位于北京路的一处房屋内，门牌号我不记得了。我在此处的职位是“代理书记员”，因为原书记员已被捕。我以此身份任职六周，之后

page_data.en:
- 2 -
transferred to the Kiangsu Provincial Committee, the offices
of which at that time were located at Yoh Long Li (晓林里)
Tikou Road. My position was clerk, and remained in this
capacity from May until September 1932, when I was ordered
by the Party to join the 10th Red Army, then engaged in
guerilla warfare. I refused to go and stayed at 567 Loong
Sie Li (陇西里), Avenue Road. As I was reluctant to
go to the front, the Party transferred me to the Communist
Youth League after the raid on the latter's headquarters in
November 1932, making me take the place of Sung Ping Woo
(陈炳权) who had been arrested and who had been the
former clerk.
I began my duties on January 1, 1933 with temporary offices
in the upstairs portion of a coffin shop opposite the Kwang
Hwa Theatre (光华戏院), Avenue Edward, French Concession.
About the middle of January we removed our offices to
5 Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen (张家花园) Medhurst Road and at the
same time had another office installed at 3 Wen Yuen Fong
(文元坊), S Kr Jau (诸家桥) French Concession.
On February 1st. Sung and myself were reading communist
documents in the premises at 5 Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen, Medhurst Rd.
and at about 3 p.m. two persons came and arrested us. Last Oct-
ober or November the Public Safety Bureau attempted to arrest
Sung Chi Ming in the French Concession but he escaped from them
and that, I think, is why they hit us with their pistol butts.
The standing committee of the Communist Youth League
consisted of Woo Kah Tien (贺克全), Sung Ch. Ming (宋志明)
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
被调往江苏省委，其办公室当时位于狄考威路 Yoh Long Li (晓林里)。我的职位是书记员，从1932年5月到9月一直担任此职，当时党命令我加入第10红军，该部队当时正在进行游击战。我拒绝前往，留在爱文义路567号 Loong Sie Li (陇西里)。由于我不愿上前线，在1932年11月共青团总部遭到突袭后，党将我调往共产主义青年团，让我接替被捕的前任书记员 Sung Ping Woo (陈炳权) 的位置。
我于1933年1月1日开始履行职责，临时办公室设在法租界爱德华路光华戏院对面的一家棺材店的楼上。
1月中旬左右，我们将办公室迁至麦赫斯特路5号 Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen (张家花园)，同时又在法租界 S Kr Jau (诸家桥) 文元坊3号设立了另一个办公室。
2月1日，宋和我正在麦赫斯特路5号 Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen 的 premises 阅读共产主义文件，下午3点左右，两个人进来逮捕了我们。去年10月或11月，公共安全局试图在法租界逮捕宋志明，但他逃脱了，我想这就是他们用枪托打我们的原因。
共产主义青年团常务委员会由 Woo Kah Tien (贺克全)、Sung Ch. Ming (宋志明)

page_data.en:
- 5 -

and myself. Woo Kuh Zien's description is as follows:-
About 5'5" in height, medium build, broad sallow face,
small eyes, brushed back short hair, wears foreign and Chinese
clothing, no peculiarities, Russian trained, can speak English
and Russian though not as well as Yung Chi Ming.

During January of this year when I was working in the
Communist Youth League, in a foreign house on Avenue Joffre
near the Kwa Tu (國泰) Theatre, I met him for dinner
four times - once a week. This foreigner is said to be a
clerk of the Communist Youth League of the United States of
America, and Yung Chi Ming told me that he was an American.
We used to discuss various phases of communism and he gave us
advice and instructions regarding the party. His description
is as follows:-
Aged between 20 and 25, 5'7" in height, slim build, light brown
hair combed back, thick eyebrows, deep set eyes, good teeth,
no glasses, fair hair on hands, thin long face, fair complexion,
broad forehead, clean shaven, smartly dressed, single shirt
cuffs, smokes cigarettes, nicotine stained fingers, fond of
beer.

I wish to see Zung Ping Woo and to renounce all connection
with the Communist Party and I desire to assist the Kuo-
mintang.

Signed;-Wong Yoong Sung.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

和我组成。Woo Kuh Zien 的体貌特征如下：
身高约5英尺5英寸，中等身材，宽黄脸，小眼睛，短发向后梳，穿洋服和中装，无特殊特征，在俄罗斯受过训练，能说英语和俄语，但不如 Yung Chi Ming 流利。

今年一月，当我在共产主义青年团工作时，在靠近 Kwa Tu (國泰) 大戏院的爱多亚路一处外国人的住宅里，我与他共进晚餐四次——每周一次。据说这名外国人是美国共产主义青年团的书记员，Yung Chi Ming 告诉我他是美国人。我们曾讨论共产主义的各个方面，他就党务向我们提供建议和指示。他的体貌特征如下：
年龄在20至25岁之间，身高5英尺7英寸，身材瘦削，浅棕色头发向后梳，浓眉，眼窝深，牙齿良好，不戴眼镜，手背毛发浅色，瘦长脸，肤色白皙，宽额头，面部刮得干净，衣着整洁，单袖口衬衫，吸烟，手指有尼古丁渍，喜欢喝啤酒。

我希望见到 Zung Ping Woo，并宣布断绝与共产党的一切联系，我愿协助国民党。

签名：-Wong Yoong Sung。

At 8 am the 9-2-33 D.S. Hunt took both male accused
to the Police Hospital where they were X-rayed.
The result of this examination however would not have been
apparent until too late for production at Court, so later,
acting on the instructions of the Officer i/c Special
Branch, D.S. Hunt obtained a Memo from Dr. Wong, the Surgeon
i/c the case, stating that both accused were fit to be
discharged from Hospital.
On the strength of this, the Officer i/c Special Branch
instructed that no further action be taken against B.P.S.
Insp: Lieu Kuh Jing (呂克勤).
The three suspected Communists and Lieu Kuh Jing again
appeared before the S.S.D. Court at 1 pm the 9-2-33.
The Police offered no evidence against the latter, and he
was released. A representative of the Bureau of Public
Safety applied for the others to be handed over for trial.
The charge sheet was endorsed as follows :-
"Tang Han Ching and Wong Sen Su, to be handed over to
the Bureau of Public Safety".
Evidence regarding the case to be handed over in one
week's time".
(At present being translated by Special Branch.)
"Yang Fung Tsung to be released on bail".
Arrangements have been made for the Court officials to

Subject (in full) Case against Tsang Han Ching (張漢卿) alias Wong Yoong Zung
(王永城) and Wong Seu Su (黄守素) alias Sung Chi Ming (孫际明).

Made by D.S.I. Everest. Forwarded by [Signature]

I forward herewith a revised list of the communist liter-
ature seized by the Municipal Police from a room on the 2nd
floor of No.5, Lane 56 Medhurst Road, on February 1, 1933.

Of the documents in question - about 120 in number- the
majority deal with communist activities in Manchuria, Kiangsi,
Kiangsu, Hunan, Hupeh, Shantung, Szechuen, Fukien and Kwangtung.
The only documents of any significance relating to local affairs
are exhibits No.5 (Cover "A") and No.15. Full translations of
these documents are being prepared.

There is no doubt that the documents are the official
records of the Communist Youth League and that the room from
which they were seized is the Central Headquarters of the
Communist Youth League.

Although the Public Safety Bureau officials since the
commencement of this case have maintained that the two male
accused arrested in the house at Medhurst Road are respectively
(1) Wong Yoong Zung (王永城) - Secretary of the Communist Youth
League and (2) Sung Chi Ming (孫际明) - Chief of the Organization
Department of the Communist Youth League, there has been no
evidence in our possession to substantiate this statement.
However, the confession of the 1st accused - Tsang Han Ching
(張漢卿) alias Wong Yoong Zung (王永城) - made before D.S. Pitts
and Clerk Zung Zoong Oen at the Police Hospital on February 6
regarding his own and the 2nd accused's connection with the
Communist Youth League removes all doubt concerning their identity.

In view of the foregoing, taken into consideration with
the statement of the female prisoner Yang Pang Tsung (楊邦貞) to
the effect that the 2nd accused actually rented and occupied
the room in which the communist documents were found at No.5,

兹随函附上修订后的清单，列明市政警察于1933年2月1日从麦特赫斯特路56弄5号二楼房间查获的共产主义文献。

在上述约120份文件中，大多数涉及满洲、江西、江苏、湖南、湖北、山东、四川、福建和广东的共产主义活动。与本地事务有关的唯一重要文件是证物第5号（封面“A”）和第15号。这些文件的完整译本正在编制中。

毫无疑问，这些文件是共产主义青年团的官方记录，查获这些文件的房间是共产主义青年团中央总部。

尽管自本案开始以来，公安局官员一直声称在麦特赫斯特路房屋内逮捕的两名男被告分别是：(1) 王永城（Wong Yoong Zung，王永城）——共产主义青年团书记，以及 (2) 孙际明（Sung Chi Ming，孫际明）——共产主义青年团组织部部长，但我们手中没有证据证实这一说法。然而，第一被告——张汉卿（Tsang Han Ching，張漢卿），又名王永城（Wong Yoong Zung，王永城）——于2月6日在警察医院向副督察 Pitts 和书记员 Zung Zoong Oen 所作的关于他自己和第二被告与共产主义青年团关系的供词，消除了对其身份的所有疑虑。

鉴于上述情况，并考虑到女囚犯杨邦贞（Yang Pang Tsung，楊邦貞）的陈述，即第二被告实际上以“林”（Ling，林）的名义租用并占据了发现共产主义文件的麦特赫斯特路56弄5号的房间，

(1) Minute of regular meeting (? of the Standing Committee of the Communist Youth League) held on January 18, 1933, to discuss ways and means to effect the release of Wong Bing(黄平 ) who was arrested in Tientsin in December 1932. The following resolutions were passed:- the
(a)To issue circular telegrams in name of mass organizations to protest against the arrest of Wong Bing, a member of the committee of the International Anti-Imperialist League and leader of anti-Japanese and labour movements.
(b)To suggest to the Chinese Soviet Government and Red Armies to offer the exchange of Kuomintang officials captured by the Red Armies for Wong Bing and other political offenders in gaol.
(c)To send masses in the name of public bodies to join the People's Rights Protection League of China in order to oppose their leaders and press them to assist in the movement to effect the release of arrested warriors.
(d)To collect contributions for the relief of the families of the arrested persons.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
A statement was taken from Tsang Han Ching (曾漢卿)
in a small room adjoining the prisoners' ward of the
Police Hospital in accordance with the instructions as
laid down in Memo. 333. In this statement, which was
given in a quite rational manner, the prisoner disavowed
all connection with communists or the Communist Party,
and gave himself out to be a respectable rice shop
merchant.
Before he was allowed to return to the prisoners'
ward, he was carefully advised to ruminate for some
time over his statement, which he had signed as being
correct, when we would talk to him again.
Wong Seu Su (黃守素) the 2nd. accused, was
then brought into the room adjoining the ward and for
some twenty minutes he was further questioned regarding
the statement that he had made on February 4, 1933.
No further information coming to light, I escorted
Wong back to the prisoners' ward, where Tsang approached
me and said that he wished to talk to me again, and that
the statement he had already made that morning was in-
correct.
Even before he commenced speaking to Clerk Zung and
the undersigned he commenced to weep, to strike his breast,
to bang his head on the floor and walls and to generally
act in a manner which suggested that he was either more

根据备忘录333的规定，在警务处医院囚犯病房旁的一间小房间里，对曾汉卿进行了问话并制作了笔录。在这份以相当理性的方式作出的陈述中，该囚犯否认与共产主义者或共产党有任何关联，并自称是一名正经的米店商人。
在允许他返回囚犯病房之前，我们仔细劝告他花些时间反思他已签字确认为正确的陈述，之后我们将再次与他谈话。
随后，第二被告黄守素被带入病房旁的房间，就他于1933年2月4日所作的陈述进一步讯问了约二十分钟。
由于未发现更多线索，我将黄押回囚犯病房，此时曾走近我，表示希望再次与我谈话，并称他当天早上所作的陈述是不正确的。
