The safety of his brother and wife had by now become a raging obsession with him and after doing our utmost to get further information from him, it was deemed inadvisable at 1.15 p.m. to question him any further. Accordingly Dr. Wong of the Police Hospital was called. He expressed the opinion that Tsang was suffering from some mental disorder, administered a morphine injection and had him placed in bed, telling us to come to-morrow (February 7) when the prisoner would be fit to be questioned further.

The prisoner, it is felt certain, will divulge further information regarding the activities of the communist party, but his concern for his relatives' safety, it would appear, has temporarily caused his mind to become unbalanced, with the result that it is well nigh impossible to obtain a coherent statement from him.

My name is Wong Seu Su ( 黃守素 ) alias Wong Shao
Yang ( 黃曉陽 ), aged 25, single, native of Huh-Wei
hsien, Anhwei, clerk by profession.
I am at present residing at No. 5 Yi Tuh Li ( 怡德里 ),
Rue Lafayette, near Rue Tenant de la Tour - the house of my
employer Sung Shui Tsoo, the Shanghai representative of the
24th. Army in Szechuen.
I studied in an elementary school in my native hsien
for several years when I was young and when I was about 17
I obtained employment as a boy with Mr. Horner, an American
Missionary in Wuhu. He treated me more as a friend than as a
boy and during my stay with him I was enabled to speak and
write very good English. I can also read and write Chinese.
At the moment I believe, Mr. Horner is in Changsha.
At the age of about 18 or 19, I recommenced my studies
at the Anhwei Middle School, where I remained for three years
studying general subjects. Leaving this academy at the age
of 22, I made my way to Szechuan, where through the recommend-
ation of an uncle who died during 1932, I secured a position
as a clerk in the HQS Staff of the 24th. Szechuan Army, my
salary being $15 per month.
I remained in this position until the Spring of 1932,
when I proceeded to Shasi ( 沙市 ), Hupeh, to see a
friend, whose name I do not remember, who was chief of the
Bureau of Public Safety in that district. I stayed with him
for three months, after which he recommended me to Sung Shui
Tsoo ( 孫煦初 ), the Shanghai representative of the 24th.

我叫黄守素，化名黄晓阳，25岁，未婚，安徽无为县人，职业为职员。
我目前居住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）怡德里5号，靠近 Tenant de la Tour 路——这是我雇主孙煦初（Sung Shui Tsoo）的住所，他是四川第24军驻上海代表。
我年幼时在家乡县立小学读了几年书，大约17岁时，我在芜湖受雇于美国传教士霍纳先生（Mr. Horner）做听差。他待我更像朋友而非听差，在他那里期间，我得以说写很好的英语。我也能读写中文。
此刻我相信，霍纳先生在长沙。
大约18或19岁时，我在安徽中学重新开始学业，在那里学习了三年普通科目。22岁离开该校后，我前往四川，通过一位于1932年去世的叔叔的推荐，我在四川第24军总部参谋处获得了一份职员职位，月薪15元。
我在这个职位上一直待到1932年春，当时我前往湖北沙市看望一位朋友，我不记得他的名字了，他是该地区公安局局长。我在他那里住了三个月，之后他把我推荐给四川第24军驻上海代表孙煦初（Sung Shui Tsoo）。

At 10 a.m. Clerk Zung and the undersigned visited the Police Hospital, Ward Road, with the object of taking a statement form Tsang Han Ching (曾漢卿 ) alias Wong Yoong Zung (王永城 ) the 1st. accused. It was evident at the outset that the prisoner was still in a state of mental disorder, but the Police Doctor stated that he was in a fit condition to be interviewed. Tsang immediately begged us to go to 232 Liaoyang Road as he had received information that his wife and brother were staying there. Asked how he knew this he stated that he had sent a note by one of the Hospital coolies to this address and had received a reply from his wife saying that she and her brother-in-law would be at this address at tiffin time to-day. A search of Tsang's clothing and bedding failed to reveal any sign of the note and the coolie who took the chit could not be found - he very probably being on night duty. It should be mentioned that with two exceptions, the addresses which the prisoner gave us yesterday, could not be located. One of these addresses - 3 Wen Yuan Fong (文元坊), Tsu Ka Jau (褚家桥) was raided by the French Police on February 2, 1933 with no results whilst the other address was visited by members of the Special Branch and detectives from

| Tsang informed us that he joined the Communist Party in the latter part of 1926 in Hankow, before the rupture between the Kuomintang and the Communist Parties. In March 1927 he came to Shanghai with the object of proceeding to Russia, but was unable to make any connection with the Communist Party in Shanghai, until December of the same year, when with 45 other young students and members of the Communist Party, he left for Vladivostock by the s.s Pingwo.
| He stayed in Vladivostock for one month before proceeding to Moscow where he studied at the Sun Yat Sen University until the end of 1931 when he returned to Shanghai to work with the Chinese Communist Party.
| At this point of the interview, the prisoner lost control of himself, exhorting us to take him to 232 Liaoyang Road, in order to arrest for safety's sake, his relations.
| Dr. Wong of the Police Hospital was called and the circumstances explained to him. He advised that the prisoner be taken to visit the address in question, which might have the effect of clearing the prisoner's

Accordingly the assistance of Bubbling Well de-
tectives was invoked and at 11.30 a.m. 232 Liaoyang Road
was visited, the prisoner accompanying us. It was
ascertained at this address that although the 1st.
accused's wife had visited the premises yesterday, she

It is fantastic to imagine that this woman would
deliberately wait at any address which she knew would
possibly be visited by the Police, be arrested and be
incarcerated in gaol, indicating without doubt that
the 1st. accused's mind must undoubtedly be unhinged.

When the prisoner realised that his wife was not
on the premises, he broke down again and another 'scene'
ensued, with the result that he was escorted back to the
Hospital.

Another attempt will be made to-morrow, or as soon

设想这名女子会故意在她明知可能被警方造访的地址等待、被捕并入狱，这是荒谬的，这无疑表明第一被告的精神肯定已经失常。

Yang Tse hung (楊世宏) ... 106 Mason

st tes;

I am single and I came to h... i ... years ago with my
mother, Yang Lieu Sz, and my two brothers, Yang Tung Ah (楊本良),
age 19, and Yang Li Yi (楊利行); age 18 years, because my father
died the same year and we had no means of subsistence. My native
address was at North Gate, Changsha, Honan. When we first came
to Shanghai, we stayed at No. 26 Lee Sing Chung, ard Road, for
about one year, and later removed to Yangtzepoc Road where we
stayed for about another year, and then removed to No. 9 May Hwo
Li, Route de Bay Soong. We only removed to the present address
No. 5 Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen on or about the 20-1-33. My elder
brother died two years ago from tuberculosis. My next brother
works in a printing works called "Tsung Ming" on Route de Bay-soong
Neither my mother obtained any work, and we subsisted on sums of
money varying from $40.00/$50.00 per month, given to us by my
mother's aunt, Tseu Lieu Sz, who formerly resided with us at No.9
May Hwo Li, Route de Bay Soong. My mother's aunt and my
brother returned to Honan on about 30-1-33. My mother's aunt
gave my mother two or three hundred dollars before she left, so we
found a new house at Lo. 5 Lane 56 Bedhurst Road (Tsang Ka Hwo
Yoen). My mother then looked for some sub-tenants, and arranged
to let the upper portion of the house to a man named Ling, his
wife, name unknown, and child, Siau Hau Doe, for $80.00 or $100.00
per month. He paid the first month's rent and moved in on the
morning of January 21st. 1933. My mother and I moved in, in the
afternoon of the same day. Mr. Ling's elder brother lived
with him in the house with us.
Ling is the man who was arrested, and I have never heard of him

杨世宏 (Yang Tse hung) ... 美生
贝尔路巡捕房 1933年2月6日 ... 1. 唐子宏 (Tang Tse hung，音译)

陈述：

我未婚，几年前与我的母亲杨刘氏（Yang Lieu Sz，音译）以及我的两个兄弟杨本良（Yang Tung Ah），19岁，和杨利行（Yang Li Yi），18岁，来到上海，因为我的父亲同年去世，我们失去了生计来源。我的原籍地址是河南长沙北门。当我们初到上海时，我们在爱多亚路（ard Road，原文不清，可能指Avenue Edward VII或类似道路）李盛宗26号（Lee Sing Chung，音译）住了大约一年，后来搬到了扬子泊路（Yangtzepoc Road，音译），在那里又住了大约一年，然后搬到了贝宋路（Route de Bay Soong，即今岳阳路或类似路段）梅霍里9号（May Hwo Li，音译）。我们仅在1933年1月20日左右搬到了现在的地址，藏家花园5号（Tsang Ka Hwo Yoen，即麦赫斯特路56弄5号）。我的大哥两年前死于肺结核。我的下一个兄弟在贝宋路一家名为“宗明”的印刷厂工作。我的母亲也没有找到工作，我们依靠我母亲的姨妈周刘氏（Tseu Lieu Sz，音译）每月给予的40至50美元不等的款项维持生计，她以前和我们一同住在贝宋路梅霍里9号。我母亲的姨妈和我的兄弟大约在1933年1月30日返回河南。我母亲的姨妈在离开前给了我母亲两三百美元，所以我们在麦赫斯特路（Bedhurst Road，原文拼写错误，应为Medhurst Road）56弄5号（藏家花园）找了一所新房子。随后我母亲寻找了一些转租人，并安排将房屋的上层部分租给一个名叫 Ling 的男子，其妻姓名不详，以及孩子小豪多（Siau Hau Doe，音译），租金为每月80或100美元。他支付了第一个月的租金，并于1933年1月21日上午搬入。我和母亲在同一天下午搬入。Ling 先生的哥哥也和他一起住在我们这所房子里。
Ling 就是被捕的那个人，我从未听说过他

page_data.en:
(3)
Yang ... Tung

being called Wong Gu Goo (黄华荣). The other man arrested with
Ling, whom the detectives call Tsang Han Ching (张汉卿); often call-
-ed on Mr. Ling, and had not left at night, when I went to bed at
9p.m., so I don't know whether he stayed or not. On the day he
was arrested he had been with Mr. Ling since 11a.m.
I went upstairs at 2p.m. that day to play with Ling's child and g
gave it food. At that time, Ling's friend left the room, but
returned later, being dragged in by another man wearing overcoat,
who was armed with a black pistol and followed by three other men.
On entering, the armed man (i.e. B.P.S. man) intimidated us to keep
quiet, with his pistol. As he (Ling's friend) was refused to
go out from the room, a fight was ensued between him and the B.P.S.
man. Mr. Ling participated in the fight assisting his friend,
but they were both overpowered by the B.P.S. man who had assistance
of his three followers, and consequently Mr. Ling and his friend
were taken downstairs by them.
My mother was in the guest room when the men came in to fight with
Ling and his friend, and she must have escaped with Ling's wife and
child on the departure of the fighters. I don't know where she
can have gone to because she has no more relations or friends in
Shanghai.
My fiancee is named Foo Yuin Ching (胡永清), aged 24, native of Sze-
chuen, and keeps a general goods store in Szechuen. He usually
stayed in Avenue Joffre (House No. unknown) Frenchtown, when he
came to Shanghai, and I occasionally stayed at his place.
page_data.zh:
(3)
杨... 本良

被称为黄华荣（Wong Gu Goo）。与 Ling 一起被捕的另一名男子，侦探们称他为张汉卿（Tsang Han Ching）；经常拜访 Ling 先生，并且在我晚上9点上床睡觉时还没有离开，所以我不知道他是否留宿。在他被捕的那天，他从上午11点起就一直和 Ling 先生在一起。
那天下午2点，我上楼去陪 Ling 的孩子玩，并给孩子喂了食物。那时，Ling 的朋友离开了房间，但后来回来了，是被另一个穿着大衣、手持黑色手枪的男人拖进来的，后面还跟着另外三个人。
进入后，那个持枪男子（即特别巡捕房人员）用手枪威胁我们保持安静。由于他（Ling 的朋友）被拒绝走出房间，他与特别巡捕房人员之间发生了打斗。Ling 先生参与打斗以帮助他的朋友，但他们两人都被特别巡捕房人员及其三名随从制服，因此 Ling 先生和他的朋友被他们带下楼。
当那些人进来与 Ling 和他的朋友打斗时，我母亲在客房里，她一定是在打斗者离开时与 Ling 的妻子和孩子一起逃走了。我不知道她去了哪里，因为她在上海再也没有亲戚或朋友了。
我的未婚夫名叫胡永清（Foo Yuin Ching），24岁，四川人，在四川经营一家百货店。他来上海时通常住在法租界霞飞路（门牌号不详），我偶尔也住在他那里。

Inspector Liao Sui Jing (呂克勤) I.S.B. accompanied by his superior Mr. Wang Yoong Mo (黃永華) attended B'well Station at 8.15a.m. the 2-2-33, and accompanied detectives to the S.M.C. Court, and gave evidence.
The case was heard in chambers, nothing fresh being divulged. At the conclusion of the proceedings, the three alleged Communists were ordered to be detained until 1p.m. the 2-2-33. The I.S.B. operative, Lieu Kuk Jing, was released on the personal guarantee of Tseu Kyi Voong (周紀鳳) Legal Representative of the I.S.B. to appear at the next hearing.
Subsequent enquiries in the vicinity of House 5 Lane 56 Ladhurst Road produced no one except the house agent Lung Sin Ming (陳彥明) who was able to give any information regarding the occupants. The latter states that the person who rented the residence, one named "Tsang", is definitely not in custody. "Tsang" is aged about 34/35 years, 5'8" medium build, spoke Shanghai dialect, and said he was an editor employed by the Commercial Press. The informant saw Tsang leaving the premises at about 1p.m. the 1-2-33. Tsang's wife who gave the appearance of being a school-teacher, was about 30 years of age, was fat and wore spectacles. They had a son aged 6/7 years, and all wore Chinese clothing habitually, whilst the two men under arrest wore foreign style clothing and are from Shansi and Anhwei respectively. RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Fracas resulting in the arrest of a member of the P.M.S. and three suspected Communists.
At shortly before 3.30p.m. the 1-2-33 C.P.C. 1817 on duty on Weihaiwei Road, observed a Chinese bleeding from head wounds emerge from the Tsang Ka Hwo Yuen (hereinafter referred to as Lane 56 Medhurst Road) and ascend a ricsha. The man appeared to be in a hurry to get away, so C.P.C. 1817 stopped the ricsha; whereupon the man tried to escape, and was arrested. He stated that he had been in a fight. At the same time a crowd emerging from Lane 56 informed C.P.C. 1817 that there were a number of robbers in the alleyway at House No. 5.
S.P.C. 91 on duty at Moulmein - Weihaiwei Roads corner was also informed. He entered the alleyway to investigate, whilst C.P.C. 1817 telephoned an alarm to B'Well Station. Uniform and Detective Squads under Inspector Chamberlain and D.S.I. Widdowson attended (3.30p.m.).
Meanwhile S.P.C. 91 accompanied by C.P.W. 1668, on approaching House 5 Lane 56, observed two Chinese struggling. He arrested them believing them to be robbers, but one showed him a Warrant Card identifying him as a member of the P.M.S., therefore S.P.C. 91 and C.P.W. 1668 accompanied the latter into House 5, where a female was also arrested. Upon the arrival of the alarm squads, the identity of the P.M.S. representative was established as, Inspector Liem Kuh Jing (梁克勤) No. 380, a special operative engaged on Communist enquiries under Mr. Wong Yeeng Hoe (黄永豪).

发生斗殴，导致一名政治保安处（P.M.S.）成员和三名疑似共产主义者被捕。
1933年2月1日下午3点30分前不久，在威海卫路执勤的华捕头目（C.P.C.）1817号观察到一名头部受伤流血的中国人从张家花园（此处以下简称赫司特路56弄）走出并登上一辆人力车。此人似乎急于离开，因此华捕头目1817号拦停了人力车；随即该男子试图逃跑，并被逮捕。他声称自己参与了斗殴。与此同时，一群从56弄出来的人告诉华捕头目1817号，巷内5号房屋里有几名强盗。
在摩尔门路-威海卫路拐角处执勤的西捕头目（S.P.C.）91号也接到了通知。他进入巷内进行侦查，而华捕头目1817号则打电话向静安寺路警察局报警。由钱伯林（Chamberlain）督察和副巡长助理威多森（Widdowson）率领的制服队和侦探队赶到（下午3点30分）。
其间，西捕头目91号在西捕（C.P.W.）1668号的陪同下，接近赫司特路56弄5号时，目睹两名中国人正在扭打。他以为他们是强盗便将其逮捕，但其中一人向他出示了 warrant card（委任证），表明其身份为政治保安处（P.M.S.）成员，因此西捕头目91号和西捕1668号陪同后者进入5号房屋，并在屋内逮捕了一名女子。随着报警小队抵达，该政治保安处代表的身份得以确认为梁克勤（Liem Kuh Jing）督察，编号380，系在黄永豪（Wong Yeeng Hoe）先生手下从事共产主义调查工作的特别行动人员。

They were sent to B'well Station and from there to the
Police Hospital, with C.D.s. 139 in attendance to take

Meanwhile a party of detectives scoured the adjacent
district for others believed to have escaped, and another
party searched House No. 5, finding a quantity of Reaction-
ary Literature in the 2nd. bedroom on the 3rd. floor, where
obvious signs showed that the fracas started. It was
removed to B'Well Station by D.P.S. Taylor and D.S.I. Tang.
When its character was known, the Special Branch were
informed, D.S.I. Everest and Clerk Chen attending.
Closer inspection disclosed the literature to be of an
important communistic character.
D.S.I. Everest, Clerk Chen and D.P.S. Taylor returned to
House No. 5 Lane 56 and seized a little more literature of
the same character, in the 2nd. bedroom on the 3rd. floor,
also a few small amounts of money etc. which will be enter-
ed later in an inventory with other seized property. An
automatic pistol-cartridge of about .380 calibre was found
in the same room. D.S.I. Everest removed the litera-

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
enquiries of the owner of the property, Hsu Liang Zung
(许良臣) and his agent Zung Siu Ming (徐秀明) both of Hse.
2 Lane 106 Redhurst Road, show that House No. 5 Lane 56
was rented to one named Tsang (张) on the 21-1-33. Tsang,
his wife and a child, together with another married couple,
both relatives, moved in on the said date. They did not
provide a guarantor, and have as yet paid no rent. The
first payment should have been made on the 1-2-33.
In view of the fact that the Special Branch carry on close
liaison work through Mr. Waung Yoong Hwo of the P.S.B. it
was arranged between Supt. Robertson and the D.C. (Crime)
that Mr. Waung's subordinate, Inspector Hiau, be not charg-
ed or unduly mortified. He is therefore technically de-
tained and a Writ of Detention applied for, on the grounds
that he is suspected of being concerned in an Assault upon
Tsang Man Ching and Wong Seu Su.
On the instructions of the D.C. (Crime) he was released at
9p.m. upon the receipt of a letter from Col. Wen Hong Ung,
Chief of the P.S.B. pledging his appearance on the 2-2-33,
when Tsang Man Ching, Wong Seu Su and Yang Pung Tsung will
be taken before the S.S.D. Court. An application will
then be made for their detention on suspicion of being
concerned in Communistic activities. The two former,
according to a chit signed by Dr. Wang of the Police
Hospital will be detained in Hospital for several days.

对业主许良臣（Hsu Liang Zung）及其代理人徐秀明（Zung Siu Ming）的查询显示，两人均住在赫德路（Redhurst Road）106弄2号，据称麦特赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）56弄5号房屋已于1933年1月21日出租给一名姓张（Tsang）的人。张与其妻及一子，连同另一对夫妇（均为亲属）于上述日期搬入。他们未提供担保人，且至今未付租金。首期租金本应于1933年2月1日支付。
鉴于特别处（Special Branch）通过公安局（P.S.B.）的王永和（Waung Yoong Hwo，音译）先生进行密切联络工作，罗伯逊警司（Supt. Robertson）与刑事副主任（D.C. (Crime)）商定，不对王的下属萧督察（Inspector Hiau，音译）提出指控或使其受到不当羞辱。因此，他在技术上被拘留，并以涉嫌参与袭击张曼青（Tsang Man Ching，音译）和黄守素（Wong Seu Su，音译）为由，申请了拘留令。
根据刑事副主任的指示，他在晚上9点获释，条件是收到公安局局长温宏英（Wen Hong Ung，音译）上校的一封信，保证他将于1933年2月2日出庭，届时张曼青、黄守素和杨鹏宗（Yang Pung Tsung，音译）将被提审至特别法庭（S.S.D. Court）。随后将申请以涉嫌参与共产主义活动为由拘留他们。据警察医院王医生签署的便条，前两人将在医院拘留数天。

Wong Seu Su who claims to be an ex-secretary of Mr. Sung Shao Kwong (孙晓光) Representative of the Szechuen Provincial Government, states that he resides at No. 5 Yee Tuh Li, Rue Lafayette, French Concession.     At about 3.30pm. when I was on beat duty at ei...ei Road

    下午约3点30分，当我在ei...ei路（原文不清）巡逻并接近宗家花园弄堂口时，我看见一名男子
乘坐公共人力车从弄堂里出来。由于此人头上盖着一件西式外套，且在流血，我产生怀疑并拦住了人力车。车夫立即试图向雅顿路（Yaten Road，音译）逃跑，最终我在油榨路（oilhaise Road，音译，原文拼写可能有误，疑为Oil Press Rd或类似）将其逮捕。经讯问，他声称在弄堂里与朋友打架，正要去警察局报案。与此同时，人群聚集并告知我弄堂内5号房还有更多劫匪。
于是我呼叫高林路（Kaulmien Road，音译，疑为Kaolimeng Rd或类似）拐角处的西捕91号（S.P.C. 91）前来支援进入弄堂，并打电话向警察局报告“抢劫”。我扣留了被捕者，直到警察小队到达。

(陳彬和) reported
to me that he had seen a communist leader Tang Ming (唐明)
entering the house No. 5, Lane 120, Route 8 (路八) and
asking for a room. I went to the house
number above mentioned to apply
for search warrant from Court.
Being on the information I received that the Tang
Ming was there, and I went to Route 8, No. 5 to be like a
customer. After viewing the front door, I went to view the
back side of house. In the meantime, the back door was suddenly
opened and two men rushed out and questioned my presence
there. I replied to them that I had come to lease house.
It appeared that they had known my informer Tang Ming Woo
(唐明和) who was formerly also a C.P. member, and are wearing the
man bearing scar mark on face (i.e. by description) is P.S.B. Det.
against C.P., these two men suddenly dragged me into the house and
straight up to the 2nd floor attempting to murder me.
Fortunately my informer followed upstairs, and in such a critical
situation we fought together and finally I became expired and was
assaulted to the ground after receiving injuries in leg and waist
and bruises on hands. As my informer was fighting with two Commun-
ists, I shouted "Communists are killing men". This alarm caused
them to flight, and I followed behind. Fortunately I obtained the
assistance of Settlement Police resulting in the arrest of these
two communists. I later requested the Settlement Police to go to
the No. 5 and arrest a female Communist, as she was assisting the
others in the quarrel, and on the other hand I accompanied the
Police party to the Police Station.

就在那里，我像顾客一样去了路八5号。在查看前门后，我去查看房屋的

幸好我的线人跟随上楼，在这危急关头我们共同搏斗，最终我力竭，腿部 and 腰部受伤，手部挫伤，被击倒在地。当我的线人与两名共产主义者搏斗时，我大喊“共产党杀人了”。这警报声导致他们逃窜，我在后面追赶。幸好我得到了租界警察的协助，从而逮捕了这两名共产主义者。随后我请求租界警察去5号逮捕一名女性共产主义者，因为她在争吵中协助其他人，另一方面我陪同警察小队前往警察局。

I am 25 years of age, and single. My native address is
at Young Tung Town, Hop-Yee Hsien, Anhwei (安徽和县杨潼镇). I live
at No. 5 Yee Tuh Li, Rue Lafayette, Frenchtown, in Shanghai.

I came to Shanghai from Szechuen in May or June last year.
I was a secretary to Mr. Lung hao Kwong (孙晓光), who was a
Szechuen Provincial Government Representative, and I lived with
him. I have been educated in middle school and can read and
write, but I have no connection with any political party.

One or two days ago I met my friend Tsang Zeu uh (张寿日)
on Avenue Haig, and he invited me to go to his home at No. 5
Tsang Ka Woo Tuen to drink, on the 1-2-48 P.M. Therefore at
about 4p.m. today I went to his home at the above address. On
entering there, 3 or 4 men inside suddenly held me up and question
-ed me for my presence there. I replied that I came to visit
friend. Then they accused me to be communist and assaulted me.
I then escaped from the house and hired a public ricsha intending
to make a report to the Police Station. At this time a C.P.C.
seeing me bleeding on the road, he asked me for the cause; I then
informed him that there were robbers in House No. 5 and I was
assaulted by them. Just at this moment, a man wearing
foreign clothes approached the policeman and alleged me to be
the robber. Therefore the C.P.C. put me under arrest and
telephoned to Police Station. On the arrival of the Police
Van, we both were taken to Police Station.

陈述：;

我今年25岁，未婚。我的籍贯是安徽和县杨潼镇（Young Tung Town, Hop-Yee Hsien, Anhwei）。我住在上海法租界霞飞路义德里5号。

我于去年五月或六月从四川来到上海。
我是四川省政府代表孙晓光（Lung hao Kwong，音译，中文名与拼音不符，前文为Sung Shao Kwong）先生的秘书，并与他同住。我受过中学教育，能读会写，但与任何政党没有联系。

一两天前，我在海格路（Avenue Haig）遇见我的朋友张寿日（Tsang Zeu uh，音译），他邀请我于1948年2月1日下午去他家位于宗家花园（Tsang Ka Woo Tuen，音译）5号的住处喝酒。因此今天下午约4点，我去了上述地址的他家。进入那里后，里面的三四个男人突然拦住我，质问我为何在此。我回答说是来拜访朋友。随后他们指控我是共产党并殴打了我。
于是我逃出房屋，雇了一辆公共人力车打算去警察局报案。这时一名华捕（C.P.C.）看见我在路上流血，便询问原因；我告诉他5号房里有劫匪，我被他们殴打了。就在此时，一个穿着西式衣服的人走近警察，诬告我是劫匪。因此华捕将我逮捕并
打电话给警察局。警车到达后，我们两人被带到警察局。

王雲程
(Proper name or: Yün Tsung)
張慶彩
Hupeh
Police Hospital 1-2-33
... . 10
translated Y.S. Fu.
stated;
I have no other alias. I am 46 years of age and married.
I live together with my wife Ong Liu Ying (王秀英) native of Honan
in a downstairs room at No. 567 Loong Ning Li, Avenue Road.
I have come to Shanghai about 1 year and two months ago. Formerly
I kept the "Dah Kong" Rice Shop, in Jukong Road, Chapoi, but this
shop was burnt in the recent Shanghai imbroglio. I have no employ-
ment at present.
My native address is at No. 346 Hwa Ching Ka (華錦街)
Hankow. I was educated in primary school and can read and write.
I received no monetary assistance from the Communists.
The only friend I have in Shanghai is one named Hoo Kuan
(胡昆) who lives in House 5 Tsang La Huo Yuen, Kedhurst Road.
At 10a.m. today, Hoo Kuan came to my home and called me to go with
him to his home to play Mah-Jongg. On arrival there, I found
insufficient persons to play. About 3p.m. two unknown men
suddenly appeared in 1st. floor room; one of whom was wearing blue
silk long gown and black fur hat, carrying a pistol, the other
wearing grey long gown, unarmed. I guessed them to be
robbers, so I attempted to escape, but I was captured by them and
hit on the head with pistol handle, causing me to bleed. (At
that moment Hoo Kuan was absent from the house) They then
dragged me downstairs. I also saw 4 other men assaulting another
man, who had been sent to the Hospital with me.
After the assault, they dragged us, two, to the alleyway. Later
several policemen arrived and we both were arrested. Afterwards
more police, foreign and Chinese, arrived and removed us to Police
Station. As we were injured, we were conveyed to the Hospital.

陈述：
我没有其他别名。我今年46岁，已婚。
我与妻子王秀英（Ong Liu Ying，音译），河南人，一起住在爱文义路龙宁里（Loong Ning Li，音译）567号的楼下房间。
我来上海大约一年零两个月。以前我在闸北朱恭路（Jukong Road，音译，疑为Zhugong Rd或类似）经营“大公”米店，但该店在最近的上海事变中被烧毁。我目前失业。
我的籍贯是汉口华锦街（Hwa Ching Ka）346号。我受过小学教育，能读会写。
我没有接受过共产党的金钱援助。
我在上海唯一的朋友是一个叫胡昆（Hoo Kuan）的人，他住在赫德路（Kedhurst Road，原文拼写错误，应为Redhurst）宗拉火园（Tsang La Huo Yuen，音译，疑为前文的Tsang Ka Woo Tuen）5号。
今天上午10点，胡昆来到我家，叫我去他家打麻将。到达那里后，我发现人数不够。下午3点左右，两名陌生男子突然出现在一楼房间；其中一人身穿蓝色丝绸长袍，头戴黑色皮帽，携带手枪，另一人身穿灰色长袍，未携带武器。我猜他们是劫匪，所以试图逃跑，但被他们抓住并用枪托击打头部，导致我流血。（当时胡昆不在屋内）随后他们将我拖下楼。我还看到另外四名男子在殴打另一个人，那个人后来和我一起被送往医院。
殴打结束后，他们将我们两人拖到弄堂里。后来几名警察到达，我们两人被捕。随后更多的中外警察到达，将我们移送至警察局。由于我们受伤，被送往医院。

Translation of a letter addressed to the Commissioner
of Police from the Commissioner of Shanghai P. S. B.

February 1, 1933.

Major Gerrard,
Commissioner of Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,

I have the pleasure to state that one of our
Detective Inspectors Lieu Kuh Jing had occasion to pass
Bubblingwell District, under your control, on business,
this afternoon, and on passing the Tsang Ka two Yuen, he
met two notorious communists namely Wong Yuin Zung and
Sung Tchi Ming. As these two communists were endangering
his life, the Detective Inspector resisted, and all fought,
which caused your Police to take these men to the Station.

Since these two communists were taken into
your custody, I wish to have them taken to Court, while I
wish Detective Inspector Lieu Kuh King to be released and
he will appear in Court tomorrow morning.

Shanghai P.S.B. Commissioner,
(Sealed) Wen Hong Ung

上海特别市公安局局长致警务处处长的信函译文。

1933年2月1日。

杰拉德少校，
工部局警务处处长。

尊敬的先生：

我很荣幸地告知，我局一名督察员刘谷静（Lieu Kuh Jing，音译）今日下午因公务经过贵处管辖的静安寺区（Bubblingwell District），在经过张家花园（Tsang Ka two Yuen，音译）时，遇到了两名臭名昭著的共产党人，即黄元宗（Wong Yuin Zung，音译）和宋志明（Sung Tchi Ming，音译）。由于这两名共产党人危及他的生命，该督察员进行了抵抗，双方发生斗殴，导致贵局警察将这些人带往警局。

既然这两名共产党人已被贵方拘留，我希望将他们送交法庭审理，同时我希望释放督察员刘谷静（Lieu Kuh King，音译），他将于明日上午出庭。

上海特别市公安局局长，
（盖章）温宏英（Wen Hong Ung，音译）
